### 题目

Social media helps people to keep in touch with friends and stay on top of news and events. Do you think the advantages of social media outweigh the disadvantages?

### 文章

Since its inception, social media has revolutionised the way people connect and access information. It has become a prevalent tool for keeping in touch with friends and staying updated on news and events. While there are clear advantages to social media in terms of connectivity and information dissemination, it is crucial to critically examine whether these benefits outweigh the potential disadvantages.

On the one hand, social media offers numerous advantages. Firstly, it serves as a powerful platform for individuals to maintain and strengthen relationships with friends. Through features such as messaging, video calls, and photo sharing, people can connect with their loved ones, regardless of geographical barriers. This enhances interpersonal connections and fosters a sense of belonging, especially in a fast-paced and globalised world. Additionally, social media plays a pivotal role in keeping users updated on news and events. It provides a real-time stream of information, allowing individuals to stay informed about local and global affairs.

Despite these advantages, it is crucial to consider the potential drawbacks of social media. One significant concern is the impact on mental well-being. Extensive use of social media has been linked to increased levels of anxiety, depression, and feelings of social isolation. The constant exposure to carefully curated highlights and reels of others’ lives can lead to self-comparison and feeling of inadequacy. Privacy and security concerns are another set of drawbacks associated with social media. Users often share personal information and details of their lives, making them susceptible to privacy breaches and identity theft.

In conclusion, while social media undeniably provides valuable means for keeping in touch with friends and staying informed about news and events, it is also crucial to acknowledge the potential disadvantages associated with its usage. Personally, I appreciate the benefits social media has to offer and believe that its drawbacks can be mitigated by fostering responsible usage practices and advocating for platform improvements, so that individuals and society can harness the benefits of social media while minimising its negative impacts.

## 第945篇

### 分数

Band 8.0

### 题目

Some people think that schools should teach students according to their academic abilities, while others believe that it is better to have students with different abilities to study together. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

### 文章

Many people argue that ability-based teaching should be used in schools, whereas others claim that mixed-ability classes are more beneficial in many ways. This essay will discuss both perspectives before explaining why I believe mixed-ability education is the better approach.

On the one hand, teaching students according to their academic level can make lessons more efficient and productive. In a class of high achievers, extra explanations may not be necessary, allowing teachers to cover more complex topics in less time. Furthermore, this teaching system helps teachers identify highly capable students and support them further. In many cases, teachers are more focused on weaker students, causing high achievers to receive less attention. Ability-based teaching can prevent this issue. Similarly, separating weaker students enables them to learn at their own pace. They can ask for clearer explanations without feeling embarrassed or pressured. This can often be seen in schools where struggling students hesitate to ask questions because they fear slowing others down.

On the other hand, labelling some children as stronger and others as weaker at an early stage of their academic life could do more harm than good. Separating children too early may cause them to lose confidence and ambition, preventing those who develop academic skills more slowly from reaching their full potential. By contrast, mixed-ability classes allow students to work together and learn from one another. When a student who understands a topic clearly explains it to a classmate, both students benefit. The student giving the explanation develops a deeper understanding of the topic, while the other is able to learn in a more relaxed and less intimidating environment.

In conclusion, while some people believe that an ability-based approach is more effective, others support mixed-ability education. In my view, the best solution is to maintain mostly mixed-ability classes while still providing additional support for weaker students and extra challenges for high achievers.

Environmental concerns and health awareness are increasingly at the forefront of public policy, motivating countries to invest heavily in promoting the use of bicycles. It seems to me that this move benefits almost every member of society and, therefore, the investment is justified.

One obvious reason for this investment is the growing recognition of the environmental benefits associated with cycling. Bicycles, as a clean and green mode of transportation, significantly reduce carbon emissions compared to motor vehicles. Cities like Amsterdam and Copenhagen, for instance, have successfully reduced their carbon footprint by implementing extensive cycling infrastructure and encouraging residents to cycle regularly. This shift improves local air quality, making cities more livable and sustainable, while simultaneously contributing to global efforts against climate change.

The promotion of cycling has a profoundly positive impact on public health. Regular bike riding is known to improve cardiovascular health, reduce stress, and enhance overall physical fitness. In Japan, where cycling is currently widely promoted, the population experienced a noticeable decrease in obesity rates and associated health problems. This improvement in public health not only enhances individual quality of life but also eases the burden on public healthcare systems, as a healthier population requires less medical intervention.

In conclusion, the investment in promoting bicycle use by some countries is a strategic response to environmental and health challenges. This approach not only aids in combating climate change and enhancing air quality but also promotes a healthier society. Despite potential initial challenges, the long-term benefits for individuals and society are significant, making this investment a positive and essential step towards a sustainable future.

### 题目

Some people think that the increasing use of computers and mobile phones nowadays has unwanted effects on young people's reading and writing skills. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

### 文章

The widespread use of computers and smartphones has raised concerns about their impact on young people's reading and writing abilities. Although excessive dependence on these devices can weaken independent literacy skills, I largely disagree that their increasing use is inherently harmful because they provide young people with greater access to information and opportunities to develop these skills.

One major benefit of digital devices is that they give students easy access to a vast amount of written material. Instead of relying solely on textbooks or spending considerable time searching for resources in libraries, young people can find academic articles, books and educational websites within seconds. Regular exposure to such material can improve their reading skills by introducing them to different writing styles, vocabulary and ideas. Moreover, computers make writing considerably more convenient because students can draft, edit and reorganise their work easily. For example, a student preparing an academic assignment can consult several reliable online sources and revise their work repeatedly before submitting it.

However, excessive reliance on technology can have negative consequences, particularly when young people use it as a substitute for independent thinking and writing. This problem has become more evident with the growing availability of artificial intelligence tools. Students can now generate essays and summaries within seconds, which may discourage them from developing their own ability to organise ideas and construct sentences. Similarly, spending excessive amounts of time consuming short online content may reduce the time young people devote to reading longer and more demanding texts. Therefore, the problem is not the technology itself but the way it is used.

In conclusion, I largely disagree that the growing use of computers and mobile phones necessarily harms young people's reading and writing abilities. While excessive dependence on digital technology and AI can weaken independent literacy skills, responsible use of these devices can provide valuable opportunities to read widely, access information and improve writing.

Some people argue that sports are essential for our physical and mental wellbeing, while others view sports as a leisure activity. Personally, I think of sports as a very important aspect of life and make an effort to be active on a daily basis.

Those who argue that sports are essential for us believe in the numerous benefits that sports offer. Firstly, sports help us to maintain a healthy lifestyle. By engaging in sports regularly, we can keep our bodies in good shape, improve our cardiovascular health, and gain muscle strength. Physical exercise helps reduce the risk of diseases such as obesity, heart disease, and diabetes. Moreover, sports can provide relief from stress and anxiety and contribute to better mental health. The social aspect of sports also promotes teamwork, leadership, and communication skills, which are valuable in personal and professional life.

On the other hand, some people see sports as an activity for leisure time. They believe that sports should not be overly emphasised in one’s life because of the limited value they provide, and that people should engage in sports only as a form of entertainment. In their opinion, sports should not be considered as a necessity but rather as an option for enjoyment.

Although there is some truth in both views, I believe that sports are essential for us. Firstly, the physical and mental benefits of sports cannot be ignored. A healthy body and mind are fundamental to the overall well-being of an individual, and sports provide an effective means of achieving both. Moreover, sports can teach us important life skills such as teamwork and communication, which are crucial in both personal and professional life.

In conclusion, sports can be seen as essential for our physical and mental well being, as well as a means of personal growth and development. There is a debate over the primary advantage of international alliances, with some arguing that its greatest benefit is environmental protection, while others believe that its main contribution is to global commerce and economic growth. I agree with the latter view.

On the one hand, international environmental agreements have played an important role in protecting the planet. Such treaties can restrict activities that cause pollution or threaten wildlife and require participating nations to take measures to reduce their environmental impact. Consequently, governments have an incentive to fulfil their obligations and avoid legal or diplomatic consequences. For example, the MARPOL Convention establishes international rules to prevent ships from discharging oil and other harmful substances into the sea, helping to reduce marine pollution and protect marine ecosystems. Nevertheless, I believe that the economic benefits of international collaboration are more significant.

On the other hand, global collaboration has a broader effect on trade and national economies. International agreements allow nations to exchange natural resources, goods and services across borders, enabling businesses to access larger markets and governments to generate revenue through exports. This foreign income can contribute to economic growth and create employment opportunities. For instance, Saudi Arabia exports petroleum to countries worldwide, generating substantial foreign revenue that supports its economic development. International trade also allows countries to obtain products and services that cannot be produced domestically on the same scale.

In conclusion, although international cooperation has helped protect the environment through treaties regulating pollution and wildlife, I believe its contribution to global business and economic development is more substantial because it creates broader economic opportunities and generates revenue for participating nations.

Some people believe that countries should produce all the food necessary to feed their populations and import as little food as possible. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

In recent years the topic of food sovereignty has become a pressing issue for many nations. It is a commonly held belief that that countries should prioritise being self-sufficient by producing all the food necessary for their citizens instead of importing it. Although this viewpoint has its merits, I believe that this is not a feasible or beneficial option.

To begin, utilising local food production will enhance a country’s national security, as this will prevent international disputes that may occur over pricing and other financial issues related to importing goods, such as taxes and other costs. In addition, local food production will promote sustainable agricultural practices according to a country’s regional climates, which will preserve local biodiversity.

However, it must be noted that this method might not be beneficial for all nations, as not every country possesses arable land or a climate that is conducive to cultivating a variety of produce. For example, countries in colder parts of the world would not have access to tropical fruits like mangoes or bananas. Therefore, importing food is vital to provide a variety of food items as well an ensuring that certain items are available even during off seasons or other times of shortage. I also believe that being exposed to food items from other countries can add to our cultural diversity and enrich our culinary experiences.

In conclusion, while it might be beneficial for some nations to strive for food self-sufficiency, for many others this approach is unrealistic and could deprive a large part of the world of the broader benefits of global trade. Therefore, a balanced combination of domestic production and imports would be a more suitable option.

## 第954篇

### 分数

Band 8.0

### 题目

Some people believe that excessive use of modern technologies, such as computers and smartphones, is negatively affecting the reading and writing skills of our young people. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

### 文章

Parents and teachers in many countries are feeling increasingly concerned about the effect of digital devices on vital skills of school-aged children. They are alarmed by the declining ability of young people to read and write and its suspected link to the influence of modern technology, and I wholeheartedly share their view. This essay will outline the reasons to watch out for the consequences of widespread use of computers and mobile phones by our youngsters.

Primary school is a very important period when children develop their fine motor skills, which are involved in learning to write. Time spent typing on a mobile phone or a tablet doesn’t contribute to the necessary workout of the small muscles in the hands and fingers of young people. Not only do they get less practice in writing but also fewer opportunities to train in spelling words, since the ‘autocorrect’ and ‘autocomplete’ features use the first few letters to guess the entire word, therefore making it unnecessary for the child to remember and type it correctly. Another companion of unrestrained use of mobile devices is the jargon that is often used in text messages, where words are shortened or distorted. Exposure to ‘texting’ tends to replace the correct words with abbreviations in young minds, causing their spelling accuracy to decline.

Reading is another casualty of unrestricted access to smart devices. Video content can be more appealing and immersive for kids and they often are automatically drawn to it instead of books. Reading requires regular practice and needs to become a habit in order to fully develop as a skill; however, it is being perceived as a boring and labourious activity by many youngsters compared to effortless video-watching. Easy and instant access to videos and movies pushes books further down the list of preferences of young audience, and it takes a significant commitment from parents and teachers to ensure that children continue to read books.

To sum up, modern technology can be a friend or a foe for young children, depending on the choices adults in their lives make, regulating the amount of screen time and its purpose. Without due care the writing and reading abilities of kids can be harmed by other, more enjoyable activities they can use the devices for.

## 第957篇

### 分数

Band 8.0

### 题目

t is important for children to learn the difference between right and wrong at an early age. Punishment is necessary to help them learn this distinction. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion? What sort of punishment should parents and teachers be allowed to use to teach good behaviour to children?

### 文章

It is often argued that children should learn the distinction between right and wrong from an early age and that punishment is necessary to teach them acceptable behaviour. While I agree that discipline plays an important role in a child's moral development, I believe that punishment should be reasonable, educational, and never involve physical abuse.

Teaching children the difference between appropriate and inappropriate behaviour is essential because it helps them develop a sense of responsibility and respect for others. Young children are not born with a clear understanding of social rules and therefore require guidance from parents and teachers. When children face consequences for their actions, they are more likely to recognise their mistakes and avoid repeating them. For example, a child who is required to apologise after bullying a classmate may better understand the impact of his or her behaviour and learn the importance of empathy.

However, not all forms of punishment are effective. Excessively harsh penalties, particularly physical punishment, can damage a child's emotional well-being and harm the relationship between the child and the adult. Research and experience have shown that children who are frequently beaten may become fearful, aggressive, or desensitised to punishment. As a result, physical discipline often fails to address the underlying cause of misbehaviour and may create long-term psychological problems.

In my view, parents and teachers should be allowed to use non-physical forms of discipline that encourage reflection and personal growth. Suitable measures include temporarily restricting access to electronic devices, reducing leisure activities, assigning additional responsibilities, or using time-outs for younger children. Furthermore, discussing the reasons behind a child's misconduct can help them understand the consequences of their actions and make better decisions in the future.

In conclusion, I agree that children must learn the difference between right and wrong and that some form of punishment can be useful in achieving this goal. Nevertheless, disciplinary measures should be constructive rather than harmful, with physical punishment being avoided altogether in favour of methods that promote learning and personal development.

The best way to provide enough homes for people living in cities is to build tall apartment blocks. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

### 文章

In many rapidly growing cities, housing shortages have become a serious concern, and some people believe that the most effective solution is to construct tall apartment blocks. I largely agree with this view, although I believe high-rise housing should be combined with careful urban planning rather than treated as a complete solution on its own.

The strongest argument in favour of tall apartment buildings is that they make highly efficient use of limited urban land. In major cities, space is often scarce and extremely expensive, so spreading houses horizontally can lead to urban sprawl, longer commutes, and the destruction of surrounding farmland or green areas. By contrast, high-rise apartments can accommodate thousands of residents within a relatively small area. For example, a single residential tower can provide homes for far more families than a row of detached houses occupying the same plot of land.

Another advantage is that dense housing can support better public services. When many people live close together, it becomes easier and more economical to provide public transport, schools, hospitals, shops, and recreational facilities. This can reduce dependence on private cars and create more convenient, sustainable neighbourhoods. If apartment blocks are well designed, with shared gardens, safe entrances, and communal spaces, they can also encourage social interaction rather than isolation.

However, simply building tall blocks is not enough. Poorly planned towers may create overcrowded, impersonal environments, especially if they lack natural light, ventilation, green space, or access to essential services. Therefore, governments must ensure that high-rise housing is affordable, safe, and integrated into the wider city.

In conclusion, tall apartment blocks are one of the best ways to address urban housing shortages because they save land and support efficient services. Nevertheless, their success depends on thoughtful design and proper infrastructure.

It is true that when people advance into their golden years, they require more help and attention. For that reason, a significant number of people hold the opinion that the government should provide financial assistance to the elderly. However, I tend to agree with those who argue that workers should be saving a portion of their income to have a nest egg in their retirement.

To begin with, a culture of saving rather than depending on the government may foster the overall economic development of a country. In other words, if people were to accumulate their own savings for their pension age, it would lessen the financial burden on the government. As a result, the government would be able to release more funds to more productive purposes, such as development of infrastructure, industries, hospitals, and so on, which may expedite the overall progression of a country.

In addition to economic factors, putting money aside has some personal benefits. Since savings-oriented people are not dependent on the state for their living expenses, this may instill a sense of self-respect and pride in them. On the other hand, those who are reliant on financial assistance very often face the negative societal stigma, as many people consider them to be inferior and unworthy members of society. Hence, to live a life with dignity and pride, taking responsibility for funding one’s own retirement is evidently a better option from individual perspective.

In contrast, the provision of monetary outlays for retirees has proven unfeasible in many countries. Since in many nations the number of senior citizens is on the rise, in the long run governments are likely to struggle to sustain the cost of providing for the elderly. The early signs of this have been seen in many countries that were forced to raise the retirement age, including my home country where men can now retire at the age of 67 instead of 65. Therefore, in the foreseeable future, these kinds of support may become completely unsustainable.

In conclusion, the provision of state monetary support may undoubtedly lessen the concern of retirees to some extent. However, considering the issue of sustainability of this provision, it is better to opt for individual savings from the very beginning of working life, for the benefit of both individual and national development.

## 第963篇

### 题目

The internet allows us to stay connected with each other no matter where we are. On the other hand, it also isolates us and encourages people not to socialise. To what extent do you agree or disagree with these statements.

### 文章

There is an ongoing debate about whether the internet helps people maintain continuous global connections or primarily breeds social isolation and deters real-world interaction. I completely agree with this view because online platforms erode meaningful face-to-face bonds and screen addiction encourages sedentary, isolated lifestyles. This essay will explain why reliance on virtual communication negatively transforms human social habits.

​The primary reason why I support this view is that online interactions lack the depth and emotional resonance of physical socialisation. This is because digital communication relies heavily on text and superficial updates, which can lead to superficial relationships and widespread emotional detachment. In other words, having hundreds of virtual contacts often fails to provide genuine companionship during times of need. For instance, studies show that young adults who spend excessive hours on social media report higher levels of loneliness compared to those who prioritise in-person meetups. Therefore, it is evident that digital connectivity often serves as a poor substitute for real human connection.

​Another important point to consider is that online entertainment actively discourages people from leaving their homes to socialise. Although some people argue that messaging applications make staying in touch effortless, I believe that this convenience destroys offline communities because individuals prefer virtual convenience over physical effort. Furthermore, digital algorithms are designed to keep users engaged continuously, which plays a crucial role in reducing time spent on group hobbies and outdoor activities. A clear example of this can be seen in modern family settings, where family members frequently sit in the same room while ignoring each other in favour of their personal devices. Thus, the internet fundamentally reduces natural social behaviour in daily life.

​In conclusion, I firmly believe that the internet ultimately isolates individuals and undermines physical socialising. This is mainly because digital connections lack authentic emotional depth , and excessive screen exposure displaces healthy real-world engagement. In the long run, this would lead to a society characterised by weakened interpersonal relationships and heightened social anxiety.

Some people believe that the purpose of education is to make individuals useful to society, while others think that education should help people pursue personal ambitions. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

### 文章

When it comes to the purpose of education, opinions are divided as some see its primary role as preparing individuals to be useful to society while others believe it should primarily serve people’s personal ambitions. In my view, education should strike a balance between these two objectives, catering to the needs of society as well as the aspirations of the individual.

Those who see education as a tool for societal utility argue that it should produce individuals who can contribute effectively to the economic and social fabric of their communities. This perspective emphasises the importance of equipping students with practical skills and knowledge that align with the demands of the job market. Such an approach is crucial for the economic development and stability of any society, because it ensures a workforce that is both skilled and employable.

However, the importance of education to individual ambitions and personal growth is hard to dismiss. Advocates of this view argue that education should nurture creativity, critical thinking, and personal exploration, allowing individuals to realise their unique potential. This approach not only fosters self-actualisation but also encourages the development of innovators and original thinkers who can contribute uniquely to society.

In conclusion, education should ideally encompass both these perspectives. By providing a balanced curriculum that caters to the practical needs of society while also encouraging individual exploration and creativity, education can produce well-rounded individuals. Their capability of contributing effectively to their communities while pursuing personal fulfillment and growth will likely lead to a more dynamic and prosperous society.

### 题目

The percentage of overweight children in Western society has increased significantly over the last decade, becoming a major public health concern. This essay will discuss the main causes of this disturbing trend and its effects on children and society.

### 文章

The percentage of overweight children in Western society has increased significantly over the last decade, becoming a major public health concern. This essay will discuss the main causes of this disturbing trend and its effects on children and society.

One of the primary causes is the busy lifestyle of parents. Many parents work long hours and have little time to prepare healthy meals at home. As a result, children often rely on fast food or ready-to-eat meals, which are usually high in calories and low in nutrients. Another important factor is the influence of social media and food delivery applications such as SkipTheDishes and Uber Eats. These companies advertise heavily through influencers, short videos, and attractive promotions, encouraging children to choose unhealthy food instead of nutritious meals. For example, a study conducted by the University of British Columbia in 2020 found that children exposed to influencer advertisements were more likely to prefer fast food.

This trend has several negative consequences. Firstly, consuming excessive amounts of junk food can lead to obesity, poor physical development, and health problems because these foods contain high levels of unhealthy fats, sugar, and salt while providing fewer essential vitamins and minerals. Secondly, the increasing use of food delivery services creates more plastic packaging waste, much of which is non-recyclable. This contributes to environmental pollution and greenhouse gas emissions. Finally, regularly purchasing fast food can place a financial burden on families because these meals are often more expensive than home-cooked food.

In conclusion, the rise in childhood obesity is mainly caused by parents' busy work schedules and the strong influence of social media advertising. Unless healthier eating habits are encouraged at home and unhealthy food marketing is better controlled, this problem is likely to continue growing.

The picture below shows the museum's plant in 1998 and after some changes were made in 2008.

### 文章

The maps illustrate the changes made to the layout of a museum between 1998 and 2008.

Overall, the museum underwent a substantial reconfiguration over the ten-year period, with the internal arrangement of several facilities being considerably altered and a number of new amenities being incorporated. Despite these extensive modifications, however, the café and the ticket entrance and exit remained broadly unchanged in terms of their location.

In 1998, a centrally positioned garden constituted the principal feature of the museum’s layout, with the café situated immediately behind it. The permanent exhibition rooms occupied the two opposing corners at the ends of the garden. Along the lower section of the premises, a ticket office was positioned adjacent to a shop, a temporary exhibition room, a toilet and a designated area for storing bags. Collectively, these facilities occupied much of the space along the southern edge of the museum.

By 2008, the original configuration had been substantially transformed. The central garden was retained but was enhanced with additional amenities, most notably fountains and a designated café seating area. The permanent exhibition rooms continued to occupy the right-hand side of the premises, effectively retaining their position along the eastern edge, whereas the exhibition facility on the left-hand side was removed altogether. The space formerly occupied by the temporary exhibition room was subsequently repurposed to accommodate the shop and the bag-and-coat storage facilities. Elsewhere, the WC was relocated to a position immediately adjacent to the café, while the temporary exhibition room itself was transferred to the western side of the garden. In addition, a restaurant was introduced in the upper corner of the museum, representing one of the most notable additions to the revised layout.

## 第969篇

### 分数

Band 8.0

### 题目

The rise of platforms like YouTube and Instagram has led many young people to spend significant amounts of time online, sometimes at the expense of their academic responsibilities. What are the consequences of this problem, and what measures can be taken to address it? Provide reasons for your answer and give relevant examples from your own experience and knowledge.

### 文章

The advent of content-sharing platforms such as YouTube and Instagram has fundamentally reshaped the leisure habits of younger generations. While these platforms offer undeniable entertainment and creative value, their excessive use has increasingly encroached upon the academic lives of students worldwide. This essay examines the principal consequences of this trend and proposes a set of concrete measures to mitigate its impact.

The most immediate consequence of unchecked social media consumption is a measurable deterioration in academic performance. When students dedicate hours each day to scrolling through short-form videos or curated lifestyle content, they invariably sacrifice time that should be devoted to study, reading, and revision. Research conducted by Common Sense Media in the United States found that teenagers spend an average of over eight hours per day on screens, leaving little cognitive bandwidth for sustained academic engagement. Furthermore, the neurological effects of platform design — particularly the dopamine-driven reward cycles engineered by algorithms — erode students' capacity for deep concentration. A student accustomed to three-second video transitions will inevitably struggle to maintain focus through a demanding mathematics problem or a dense literary text.

Beyond academic performance, prolonged platform engagement carries significant psychological consequences. The culture of comparison fostered by Instagram, where carefully curated images project idealised standards of beauty, wealth, and social success, has been strongly associated with heightened levels of anxiety and depression among adolescents. A landmark 2017 study by the Royal Society for Public Health in the United Kingdom identified Instagram as the social media platform most detrimental to young people's mental health, citing its links to poor body image and inadequate sleep patterns. Students grappling with such psychological burdens are poorly positioned to perform at their academic best, creating a reinforcing cycle of distraction and underachievement.

Addressing this problem demands a coordinated response from schools, families, and technology companies alike. Educational institutions should integrate structured digital literacy programmes into the curriculum, equipping students not merely with technological skills but with the critical awareness to manage their own usage habits. Schools in Finland, for instance, have adopted screen-free periods during the school day as part of a broader wellbeing strategy, yielding demonstrably positive outcomes for student focus and classroom engagement. At the family level, parents must model responsible digital behaviour and establish clear, consistent boundaries around device use during homework hours, treating screen time management as a dimension of parenting no less important than diet or sleep.

Technology companies, for their part, bear a profound ethical responsibility to protect younger users. Regulatory pressure has already prompted platforms to introduce features such as daily usage reminders and content filters; however, these measures remain largely voluntary and cosmetic. Governments would do well to mandate more robust age-verification systems and algorithmic transparency, ensuring that profit-driven engagement mechanics are not permitted to systematically undermine the educational prospects of an entire generation.

In conclusion, the unconstrained use of social media platforms poses serious threats to both the academic performance and the psychological well-being of young people. Through a combination of school-based education, informed parenting, and meaningful regulatory intervention, society can cultivate an environment in which young people engage with digital platforms purposefully rather than compulsively, allowing technology to serve their development rather than obstruct it.

Some people claim that it is acceptable to use animals in medical research for the benefit of human beings, while others argue that it is wrong. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

### 文章

People have different views on how medical research should be conducted and tested. Although many people support the use of animal experimentations for developing medicines, I personally believe that animal testing is morally wrong.

The main reason why some people value animal experimentations to conduct medical research is because animal testing has contributed to many life-saving cures and treatments. It is true that nearly every medical breakthrough in the last 100 years has resulted directly from research using animals. For example, experiments in which dogs had their pancreases removed led directly to the discovery of insulin, critical to saving the lives of diabetics. Furthermore, it is impossible to release new drugs to the market before proving it has no harm to humans and laboratory mice are appropriate research subjects because they are similar to human beings in many ways.

However, I support with people who consider medical development that involved the use of animals is cruel and unacceptable. I believe that the lives of all creatures should be respected and we, humans, have no right to suffer animals for our own benefits. Governments should invest in developing alternative methods that can replace using animal experimentations when doing medical research. For example, a software program can be developed to model a human immune system and new drugs can be tested on the software rather than animals. In this way, no animals will suffer from the medical tests and the society can still benefit from medical development.

In conclusion, although it is undoubtedly true that animal testing has helped scientists in drug developments and medical discoveries, I believe that the benefits to humans do not justify the suffering caused to animals and we should use alternative methods when doing medical research that do not involve animals suffering.

## 第971篇

### 分数

Band 8.0

### 题目

The world of work is changing rapidly. Working conditions today are not the same as before and people no longer rely on taking one job for life. Discuss the possible causes for these changes and give your suggestions on how people should prepare for work in the future.

### 文章

Workplaces have always evolved, but the pace of change in recent decades has made it increasingly difficult for workers to maintain stable careers or anticipate the conditions they will encounter by retirement. This acceleration is largely driven by rapid advancements in technology and artificial intelligence, which are disrupting entire industries at speeds previously unimaginable. This essay will examine the primary causes of this transformation and suggest how individuals and governments can best prepare for the future of work.

Over the past five decades, humanity has witnessed more technological advancement than all previous generations combined, fundamentally altering the nature of employment. Roles that once endured for entire careers are now being created and rendered obsolete within years rather than generations. In the late 1990s, for instance, telephone operators held respectable and well-paying positions across industries; however, the introduction of automated systems and smartphones eliminated this profession almost entirely within a single generation. More recently, the demonstrated capabilities of artificial intelligence and large language models have begun challenging workers in fields previously considered resistant to automation, such as software engineering and scientific research — disciplines that represent the academic aspirations of millions. Consequently, workers across all skill levels are confronting the real possibility of displacement, generating widespread uncertainty about long-term employment security.

To navigate this uncertainty, individuals must first adopt a mindset of continuous learning rather than treating formal education as a one-time qualification. Workers who regularly update their competencies — through professional certifications, online courses, or self-directed study — are considerably better positioned to remain employable across multiple roles throughout their careers. Furthermore, rather than pursuing broad generalist qualifications, individuals should identify specialised areas less susceptible to automation, particularly fields requiring human creativity, emotional intelligence, or complex contextual judgment. Developing proficiency across multiple disciplines simultaneously offers the most durable protection against displacement, as versatile professionals capable of operating across domains are far harder to replace than narrow specialists. Governments, meanwhile, should implement regulatory frameworks that moderate the pace of workforce automation, ensuring displaced workers receive targeted retraining support and that basic economic security is maintained during periods of transition.

In conclusion, the accelerating pace of technological change represents an unavoidable restructuring of the working world rather than a temporary disruption. While individuals cannot control the direction of these developments, committing to lifelong learning, cultivating specialised and cross-disciplinary skills, and remaining adaptable offers the most effective response. Simultaneously, government intervention is essential to ensure the benefits of automation are distributed equitably and that vulnerable workers are not abandoned in the process.

## 第973篇

### 分数

Band 8.0

### 题目

There are many animal species that are close to extinction. Some say that only animals that are beneficial should be protected. Do you agree or disagree?

### 文章

As global extinction rates accelerate, some argue that conservation efforts should focus strictly on animal species that provide direct benefits to humanity. This essay completely disagrees with this approach because selective protection threatens to destabilize entire ecosystems and risks destroying species with undiscovered scientific and medical value.

First, protecting only a small subset of animals disrupts the natural food webs that sustain all life. Every species, regardless of its perceived utility to humans, occupies a specific niche within its environment. If one organism is allowed to go extinct, the resulting imbalance can severely impact predator and herbivore populations alike. For example, if apex predators are removed from an ecosystem, herbivore populations rapidly multiply, leading to overgrazing and land degradation. This chain reaction ultimately collapses the local habitat, demonstrating that every creature is vital to ecological stability.

Second, many species that currently appear unproductive or even dangerous may possess immense, unexamined biomedical potential. Wildlife holds complex evolutionary traits that frequently lead to medical breakthroughs when researched. For instance, chemical compounds derived from scorpion and snake venom—substances traditionally viewed as harmful—are now actively used to develop treatments for chronic diseases, including certain types of cancer. If these creatures were left to perish due to their lack of immediate utility, society would lose invaluable resources for future innovation.

In conclusion, limiting protection to explicitly beneficial animals is a short-sighted strategy. Universal conservation is essential not only to prevent global ecological collapse but also to safeguard wildlife that may hold the key to future scientific discoveries.

### 文章

Education plays an imperative role in the overall progression of a country. Many people may heavily rely on quality education as preparation for real life employment and experiences. However, there are other factors that are needed to propel a country towards success.

We must acknowledge the way the education system of a country prepares most individuals by equipping them with various skills. Prior to gaining a qualification to practice certain professions such as teaching, nursing or accounting, it is necessary for the individuals to undergo rigorous training. Certificate and diploma programs as well as university degrees are good examples of that. Some graduates may even choose to pursue further studies to attain certain requirements to be able to practice their chosen profession.

The education system is undoubtedly important in preparing individuals to take on roles leading to the development of a country. However, it seems that producing graduates alone isn’t a guarantee of the advancement of a country. There are other factors that should come into play, and motivation of individuals is one. Without motivation, people may lose track of what they intend to do to contribute to the improvement of a country. Motivation drives people to achieve and maximize their potentials, because they are determined to get better at many aspects of their life, eventually yielding improvement for their entire country.

Furthermore, the availability of natural resources and job opportunities may also affect the growth of a national economy. Innovations of many individuals require raw materials, and should the country be able to mine these, their production and perhaps even export may help in stabilizing the local market. Finally, it is also important that the availability of employment is aligned with the skills of individuals applying for the positions. Giving skilled people the opportunity to apply their knowledge and experience in their profession makes them more productive, which contributes to GDP growth.

In conclusion, education continues to play a pivotal role in the development of a country. However, other important factors should play a role in order to achieve steady and continuous progress.

## 第979篇

### 分数

Band 8.0

### 题目

There seems to be an increasing number of serious crimes committed each year.While some think the best way is to use the death penalty as a deterrent, ,many believe that other meausres will be needed. Discuss both sides.

### 文章

In some countries, serious offences appear to be increasing each year. Some argue that capital punishment is the strongest deterrent, whereas others believe broader social policies are required. I believe the ultimate penalty may be justified in a small number of extreme cases, but lasting public safety depends more on prevention, legal education and rehabilitation.

The case for execution is based mainly on deterrence and protection. When an offender commits murder or a terrorist attack, society may need a sanction severe enough to reflect the gravity of the harm. A life sentence can keep that person away from the public for many years, but supporters worry that a dangerous prisoner might eventually be released and offend again. The possibility of execution may also make potential offenders think twice before carrying out violent acts, since they know the consequences could be irreversible.

However, harsh sentencing alone cannot deal with the conditions that lead people into unlawful behaviour. In poor communities, young people who cannot find stable work may be drawn into theft, robbery or drug dealing because these activities seem to offer quick money. A preventive strategy would provide vocational training, job creation and basic income support, giving them a lawful route to a decent life. Such policies reduce the motivation to break the law before harm is done.

Education and rehabilitation are equally important. Schools can teach teenagers about violence, fraud and property offences, allowing them to understand how a criminal record can damage future study and employment. For those already in prison, counselling and skills programmes can help them accept responsibility, learn a trade and prepare for release. This lowers the risk of reoffending, which helps protect society more sustainably than relying only on the fear of severe punishment.

In conclusion, capital punishment may deter the most extreme violence, but it should not be treated as the main answer to rising offending. Governments should combine necessary penalties with policies that improve living conditions, build legal awareness and help prisoners return safely to society.

It is undeniably true that advertising uses persuasive techniques, like skilful storytelling or interesting visuals to make a product seem more appealing to customers. In essence, adverts are designed to make people believe that they need to buy a product to achieve a certain lifestyle or social status, and this strategy can indeed lead to an increased purchase of goods that are not strictly necessary for one’s well-being or happiness. However, it is also crucial to acknowledge that advertising also serves informative purposes, as it introduces consumers to new products and innovations that can genuinely enhance their quality of life or offer solutions to their problems. For instance, advertising can play a pivotal role in raising awareness about energy-efficient appliances, health-related products, or educational services. Furthermore, advertising supports economic growth by helping businesses reach their target audiences, and it also facilitates healthy competition which is often the driving force behind product improvement.

## 第981篇

### 分数

Band 8.0

### 题目

These days, if people have health problems, many do not visit doctors. They try to get better at home by themselves. Is this a positive or negative development?

### 文章

These days, an increasing number of individuals are attempting to manage their health conditions at home rather than consulting doctors. Although self-care may be appropriate for minor ailments, I believe that avoiding professional medical advice is a negative development because it can pose significant risks to people's well-being. In particular, it may result in delayed diagnoses and inappropriate use of medication.

Firstly, managing illnesses at home can delay the detection of potentially serious medical conditions. Individuals without adequate medical knowledge may struggle to distinguish between minor symptoms and signs of a severe disease. As a result, they may rely on home remedies or simply wait for their symptoms to subside. This can be dangerous. If an underlying condition remains undiagnosed, it may progress and become considerably more difficult to treat. For example, persistent chest pain or unusual fatigue may initially appear harmless, even though these symptoms can sometimes indicate a more severe condition. Therefore, without an accurate diagnosis and timely medical intervention, patients may face preventable health complications.

Furthermore, self-medication can result in inappropriate treatment. Without guidance from a qualified healthcare professional, individuals may select unsuitable medicines, take an incorrect dosage, or use a drug for longer than recommended. Not only can these practices cause adverse side effects, but they may also aggravate an existing condition. For instance, some individuals take antibiotics whenever they develop symptoms of a cold, despite these drugs being ineffective against viral infections. Their unnecessary use can also contribute to antibiotic resistance, making bacterial infections increasingly difficult to treat. Thus, self-medication may create additional health risks rather than addressing the original illness effectively.

In conclusion, I firmly believe that managing medical conditions at home without appropriate professional guidance is a negative development. While minor ailments can sometimes be managed through self-care, avoiding doctors when professional treatment is necessary may delay diagnosis and expose individuals to inappropriate treatment.

### 题目

Some people say that too much attention and resources are given to the protection of wild animals and birds. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

### 文章

In recent years, the increasing allocation of resources for the protection of wild animals and birds has given rise to the question of whether or not it is justified. While some argue that these efforts are crucial for maintaining biodiversity, others believe that the resources and attention dedicated to this cause are excessive. Personally, I think that humanity has other needs that are equally worthy of funding.

The first point to consider is that the disproportionate focus on wildlife conservation often overshadows more pressing human concerns. For instance, resources allocated for the protection of a single endangered species could potentially be redirected to address urgent human needs, such as healthcare, education, or poverty alleviation. In developing countries, where resources are particularly scarce, the choice to prioritise wildlife over critical human issues can be especially problematic. For example, in some African nations, vast sums are invested in protecting certain wildlife species, while basic human necessities remain unmet for a significant portion of the population.

Furthermore, excessive focus on wildlife protection can lead to unintended negative consequences for local communities. Often, conservation efforts involve restricting access to natural resources that communities have traditionally relied upon, leading to economic hardships. In parts of Asia, for instance, the establishment of protected areas for tigers has sometimes resulted in the displacement of indigenous communities or restrictions on their access to forest resources, which are vital for their livelihoods. Not only does this create conflict between humans and wildlife, but it also raises ethical questions about the fairness of such conservation strategies.

In conclusion, while the protection of wild animals and birds is unquestionably important, striking a balance is crucial. The current overemphasis on wildlife conservation, often at the expense of addressing human needs and respecting the rights of local communities, suggests a need for rethinking. A sustainable approach should consider both environmental and human factors equally.

## 第983篇

### 分数

Band 8.0

### 题目

Under British and Australian laws a jury in a criminal case has no access to information about the defendant's past criminal record. This protects the person who is being accused of the crime. Some lawyers have suggested that this practice should be changed and that a jury should be given all the past facts before they reach their decision about the case. Do you agree or disagree?

### 文章

In criminal trials, juries in Britain and Australia are generally not told about a defendant’s previous convictions, as this may prejudice their judgement. Some lawyers argue that jurors should instead have access to all past facts before deciding a case. I mostly disagree with this proposal because a verdict should be based on evidence relating to the specific crime being tried.

The strongest reason for keeping criminal records from the jury is that they can create unfair bias. If jurors know that a defendant has committed offences before, they may assume that the person is guilty again, even when the evidence in the current case is weak. This would undermine the principle that every accused person should be presumed innocent until proven guilty. For example, someone with a previous conviction for theft might be unfairly judged in a later robbery case simply because of their past, rather than because of reliable evidence.

Moreover, allowing past records into court could distract jurors from the central question: whether the defendant committed this particular crime. A justice system should punish proven actions, not a person’s general character. If background information becomes too influential, trials may turn into moral assessments of an individual’s life rather than careful examinations of facts, witnesses, and forensic evidence.

However, there may be limited exceptions. If a previous offence is directly relevant to the present case, such as showing a highly specific pattern of behaviour, a judge could decide whether it should be admitted. This would protect fairness while still allowing important evidence when truly necessary.

In conclusion, I believe juries should not normally be given access to a defendant’s past criminal record. Justice is best served when decisions are based on the facts of the current case, with only carefully controlled exceptions.

When asked to choose between a life without work and working most of the time, people would always choose not to work. Do you agree or disagree?

### 文章

Many people dream of having enough financial security to stop working altogether. Consequently, some argue that, if given the choice, everyone would prefer a life free from work rather than spending most of their time working. While this may be true for those who find their jobs stressful or unrewarding, I disagree with the claim that people would *always* choose not to work.

It is understandable why some people would prefer a life without work. For many individuals, employment is primarily a means of earning a living rather than a source of personal fulfilment. Long working hours, demanding workloads, and workplace stress can leave employees with little time for family, hobbies, or relaxation. As a result, if financial concerns were removed, many would choose to devote more time to travelling, pursuing personal interests, or spending time with loved ones. Such a lifestyle could significantly improve both physical and mental well-being.

However, paid employment fulfils important psychological and social needs that leisure alone cannot fully satisfy. Beyond providing an income, meaningful work gives people a sense of purpose, achievement, and identity. For example, many doctors, teachers, and researchers continue working despite having sufficient financial resources because they value the opportunity to contribute to society and apply their expertise. Moreover, the workplace offers opportunities for social interaction, personal growth, and continuous learning, all of which help people maintain motivation and self-worth. Without these experiences, some individuals may eventually feel isolated or lack a clear sense of direction, even if they enjoy complete financial freedom.

In conclusion, although many people would welcome greater freedom from work, it is unrealistic to claim that everyone would choose not to work if given the opportunity. For many, meaningful employment represents far more than a source of income, making it an indispensable part of a fulfilling life.

## 第987篇

### 分数

Band 8.0

### 题目

With the wide use of computers and the Internet, people can study and work from home without going to school or company. Do the advantages outweigh its disadvantages?

### 文章

The widespread adoption of computers and the internet has fundamentally transformed how people learn and earn, making remote education and employment increasingly viable alternatives to traditional institutions. While this shift offers genuine advantages in terms of accessibility and efficiency, this essay argues that the disadvantages — particularly the erosion of social development and the challenges of self-regulation — ultimately outweigh them.

Proponents of remote study and work correctly highlight significant practical benefits. Geographically isolated individuals, for instance, can access quality education without the financial and time costs of commuting, simultaneously reducing their carbon footprint. For businesses, eliminating physical office space substantially lowers operational expenses, while employees who thrive under self-directed conditions often report higher productivity due to greater control over their schedules and environments. These gains are real and should not be dismissed.

However, these advantages are conditional and do not apply universally. Research on early adopters of online education consistently reveals measurable deficits in interpersonal skills — children and young adults who lack exposure to collaborative, face-to-face environments demonstrate weaker abilities to read social cues, communicate effectively, and build professional relationships, all of which are critical to long-term career and personal success. Furthermore, the assumption that remote work increases productivity holds only for highly disciplined individuals. Studies document widespread issues among remote workers, including poor time management, boundary erosion between domestic and professional responsibilities, and elevated rates of anxiety and depression stemming from prolonged social isolation.

In conclusion, while remote study and work offer genuine efficiency gains, they come at a substantial cost to social cohesion, mental health, and the development of interpersonal competence. Since these are foundational to both individual fulfilment and collective productivity, the disadvantages outweigh the advantages, and traditional institutions retain an important role that digital alternatives cannot fully replicate.

Band 8.0

### 题目

Some people think that dangerous sports should be banned, while others believe that people should be free to do any sports or activities. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

### 文章

Opinions are sharply divided over the issue of whether dangerous sports should be banned. Some advocate for prohibition due to significant safety concerns, while others argue for the preservation of individual autonomy, emphasising that people should have the freedom to pursue any sports or activities they choose. Personally, although I acknowledge the legitimate concerns about safety, I believe that the principle of individual freedom should prevail.

Those in favour of banning dangerous sports often cite the significant risks involved such as severe injuries or even death. Activities like cliff diving or extreme mountain biking carry inherent dangers that often lead to severe or even fatal accidents. What is more, many impressionable young people are not fully aware of the consequences of participating in such activities. For these reasons, banning extreme sports is necessary to prevent unnecessary harm and the emotional and financial impact on the participants as well as their families.

Conversely, advocates for personal freedom believe that everyone should be free to choose their activities, regardless of the associated risks. They argue that high-risk sports can be incredibly rewarding, and offer personal growth and an unparalleled adrenaline rush. They further point out that with meticulous training and implementation of strict safety measures, the dangers of these sports can be considerably reduced. For instance, with thorough training and stringent safety protocols, the risk of skydiving can be substantially lowered, allowing participants to enjoy these activities responsibly.

In my view, while safety is crucial, it should not overrule people’s freedom to choose their sports. Banning dangerous sports outright might prevent some accidents, but it also strips away the right to make personal choices about risk-taking. A balanced approach, where high-risk sports are regulated through strict safety measures and informed consent is a more reasonable solution.

The main reason why I believe athletes should behave well at all times is that their behavior is tremendously influential. Spectators respect players and many copy their actions and behavior; therefore, if top players misbehave or violate laws, some of the fans may feel compelled to follow their example and behave badly. For example, after an acclaimed baseball player was caught using drugs some years ago, the number of people who were arrested for the same crime significantly increased. This shows quite clearly why high profile players should consider their actions very carefully in order to promote a peaceful society.

In addition, the behavior of athletes might affect the popularity of their sports. Some companies sponsor successful athletes who boost their brand recognition and sales of their products. Players and sports industry executives are financially compensated for endorsing products and participating in commercial advertisements. If they demonstrate poor behavior, sponsors could direct their money elsewhere, and as a result sports matches could suffer due to lack of funds. To illustrate, Sumo, a traditional Japanese sport, is held every season thanks to resources donated by companies. In a year when a Sumo player was involved in a violent crime, no matches were held, resulting in a large deficit of funds.

In conclusion, I completely disagree with the opinion that top athletes are permitted to behave badly because their behavior may negatively influence the public behavior and sports industry itself.

## 第994篇

### 分数

Band 8.0

### 题目

Some people think that public health within a country can be improved by government making laws regarding nutritious food. Others, however, think that health is a matter of personal choice and responsibility. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

### 文章

Personal and public health are tightly related to food choices. While some people believe that the government should regulate nutrition to improve public wellness, others argue that it should be people’s decision whether to pursue a healthy diet or not. This essay will discuss both points of view and explain why the authorities should not control the types of food people can buy.

Legislators could impose laws concerning nutritious food in an effort to have a healthier population, therefore, decreasing public health costs. Even if this could be considered a good idea, it would be very quite difficult to implement. To achieve this target, the rulers could impose a levy on unhealthy food options, or reduce their availability on the grocery stores shelves. In Italy, for example, products such as carbonated sugary drinks and chips are heavily taxed. As a result, the sales of these items have decreased. However, if the authorities start to take control of what their citizens can or cannot eat, it may be seen as limitation of freedom.

Since personal freedom is an extremely important human right, many people think that they should be responsible for their choices regarding the food and drinks they decide to consume. I agree with this opinion because limiting nutritional options, even if it is done with the best outcome in mind, could consequently create dissatisfaction among the population, which would possibly lead to other public issues such as protests and demonstrations. A better approach could be educating the public about a healthy diet, which would help people make better-informed decisions about the food they consume. Many developed countries around the world employed this strategy and saw public health gains.

In conclusion, even though the government is able to control the dietary habits of its population through taxation and restrictions, healthier citizens and reduced public health expenses isn’t the only possible outcome. Limiting personal freedom could result in social unrest and for that reason diet decisions are better to be left up to well-informed individuals.

## 第995篇

### 分数

Band 8.0

### 题目

Some people think that schools should select students according to their academic abilities, while others believe that it is better to have students with different abilities studying together. Discuss both views and state your own opinion.

### 文章

Some people contend that mixed ability classes are more beneficial for children’s development than streaming them on the basis of judgement about their academic abilities. However, from my perspective, I disagree with this contention.

Admittedly, mixed ability classes provide a better environment for children’s all-round development. In such classes, children with different abilities study together and in turn they can learn from one another. From example, a student, who is good at academic study but weak in dancing or painting, can learn how to dance or paint form his peers. In this sense, mixed ability classes allow students to develop their abilities in different subjects instead of only academic abilities.

Despite the argument above, I believe streaming students brings more benefits to teachers and students. As for teachers, separating children with better academic abilities from others facilitates effective teaching. This practice helps teachers to control their students more conveniently and easily. Compared with mixed ability in which teacher should consider students’ differences when they are using teaching methodologies, streaming makes this situation simpler. To be more specific, students are at the same level of academic ability in a class, and in turn teachers can use the same methodologies for them all. In this way, the narrower the spread of ability in the class, the more convenient the teaching can be.

On top of this, steaming enables students to learn in an effective way. According to students’ different abilities, they are taught in different ways that are more suitable for them. In the top streams, students use more difficult materials, therefore, they can learn more. In sharp contrast, teachers can explain the material more slowly to those in bottom streams. Under this circumstance, students with different academic abilities can study effectively and efficiently.

In the final analysis, mixed ability classes are beneficial for students’ versatile development, but in my opinion, segregating students based on different academic ability is better for both teachers and students.

For instance, companies could send out gifts after successful projects and parents could take their children on family trips to celebrate birthdays.

### 题目

Some people use the Internet to search for solutions to their medical problems, is this a positive or negative development?

### 文章

At present, the Internet plays a vital role in almost every aspect of human life. As a result, individuals are searching online in order to get reasonable solutions to their illnesses. Not everyone is convinced that access to such information online is safe and helpful. However, in my view, providing the general public with access to trustworthy information about medical disorders would invariably improve the quality of the medical care for the whole society.

Nowadays, even though there are plenty of online platforms have been developed for medical education, most of the sites have not been written by professional healthcare providers. Hence, there is a high possibility of spreading wrong medical information throughout the world, unless the site developers are held accountable for the content they provide. If patients receive incorrect information about a medical procedure and follow the wrong advice, for instance, to remove a wart at home, it might lead to a serious infection, excessive bleeding or another medical emergency. That would constitute a negative effect of using online knowledge for medical treatments at home rather than visiting a professional.

On the flip side, for the sake of the Internet, the society is well aware of most common medical disorders and preventive measures. Consequently, a reasonable and prudent individual can decide whether to get professional opinion on one’s disease or to handle it at home, providing that they get reliable online medical information. Moreover, if patients can manage mild medical problems themselves, it would certainly reduce the workload at the local hospitals, freeing more doctors for patients in real need. Besides, if patients come with a certain extent of knowledge about their condition to the medical consultation, it would invariably be helpful to the medical practitioner for effective decision making.

To sum up, it is evident that online search for information on medical disorders can be a positive development as long as the general public receives trustworthy information.

## 第998篇

Band 8.0

### 题目

Some say that reading newspapers and watching TV news is a waste of time, because it has no direct connection with people’s lives. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

### 文章

In the digital era, there is a growing belief that newspapers and TV news are outdated since these traditional news sources have no direct relevance to people’s personal lives. I, however, disagree with this perspective as it overlooks the broader role of news in shaping an informed society.

It is crucial to understand that all forms of news offer useful insights into events that add to our overall understanding of the world. This awareness helps people to develop a more profound insight into the world beyond their own country. As the world becomes increasingly interconnected, individuals need to be aware of global newsworthy situations as actions in one part of the globe can quickly cause ripple effects elsewhere. For example, during the Brexit negotiations, comprehensive news reports helped people worldwide understand the economic and political ramifications, not just for the UK and Europe, but for global trade and travel.

Another important point to consider is that news media act as watchdogs that hold those in power accountable. By reporting on government policies, societal issues, and public opinions, newspapers and TV news ensure that citizens are well-informed, which is essential for making responsible voting decisions. While it is true that the immediacy of social media and the internet might provide more direct engagement with our immediate interests, it would be a mistake to dismiss traditional news sources as outdated and irrelevant. Newspapers and TV news offer a broader, more in-depth perspective on the world, which is invaluable for developing a well-rounded worldview.

In conclusion, while newspapers and TV news might not always have a direct influence our personal daily experiences, their contribution to our understanding of the broader world, democracy, and social issues is significant. Dismissing them as a waste of time, in my view, overlooks the essential role they play in creating and shaping an informed society.

Some say that rich countries should help poor countries with trade, health and education. Do you agree or disagree?

### 文章

Improvements in health, education and trade are essential for the development of poorer nations. Some say that the governments of richer nations should take more responsibility for helping the poorer nations in such areas. In my opinion, the aid of wealthy countries is imperative to fight poverty in developing nations.

Today’s world has been divided into developing and industrialised countries which the main difference between them is the amount of money that governments apply in important sectors such as education, health and commerce. Most of the poorer nations are buried in debts as a result of their unbalanced finances which are reflect in a failed health care, an unstructured education system and a weak international trade. This vicious cycle will continue indefinitely unless wealthier nations show interest in minimizing the worldwide economic differences, as well as taking more responsibility for assisting less fortunate countries.

Most of the African countries live in sub-human conditions because of the extreme poverty, upheaval, hunger, disease, unemployment, lack of education and both inexperienced and corrupt administrations. The devastating consequences of the AIDS epidemic in those countries could improve if the infected population were to receive free drugs to control the disease, have access to health professionals and get information on how to prevent its spread. But this can only be achieved through international help programs in which leaders of the world’s richest countries donate medicine and also send doctors and nurses to treat and educate those in need.

Moreover, most of the poor countries rely on selling agricultural products and raw materials to rich nations and buying industrialized products from them resulting in a huge financial deficit. Consequently, they borrow a significant amount of money from the World Bank to try to improve their broken economies, but sometimes the money disappears with no significant changes and they cannot even pay the interest to the bank. Recognising this as an issue that wealthy countries can resolve, last year the G8, which is comprised of leaders of the eight richest nations, decided to forgive billions of dollars worth of debt owed by the world’s poorest nations. In addition, they developed adequate loan programs to financially assist those countries.

In conclusion, leaders of the industrialised countries play an indispensable role in assisting developing nations in dealing with essential areas such as health, education and trade. Their aid is the key to breaking the vicious cycle poorer countries are locked in, which results in poverty and death.
