### 题目

Some think that young people should be free to choose any career they like, while others say that they should think more realistically about their future. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

### 文章

Choosing a future career requires careful consideration. While some people claim that adolescents should be able to pursue a career they would enjoy, others oppose to that, arguing that teenagers should aim for a high-paying job in order to secure a livelihood when they grow up. Given that our life consists of more than just physiological needs, I strongly believe that it is vital to fulfill one’s potential in the career fields that are most compatible with their interests.

The youth who choose highly skilled jobs may find it easier to have a fruitful future in a materialistic sense. It is true that some professions, such as engineers or doctors, are well paid and offer more stability compared to work in other, non-professional fields. For example, psychologists usually have higher starting salaries compared to artists; they also rarely lose their jobs in recessions. People who prioritise earning a living might agree that a reliable job is a must for their future and by no means will they take risks to gain employment in a field they are passionate about, that doesn’t pay well.

However, it is worth remembering that we are living in a rapidly changing world and the concept of a ‘guaranteed future’ is unrealistic. Even the smartest of us aren’t prophets and it is impossible to foresee many changes in job markets in the future; some high-salaried jobs of today may no longer exist by the time our young people become adults. Therefore, people may choose to pursue their dreams and follow career paths according to their passions and interests now, to avoid having regrets later in life.

Having considered the reasons to prefer monetary remuneration over one’s interests, I am convinced that it would be a pity for youths to limit their career choices to highly paid jobs of today. Unforeseen changes in the jobs markets may affect salaries but won’t change the pleasure one derives from doing something they love.

## 第1001篇

### 分数

Band 8.5

### 题目

Some people believe that technology has made communication between people less personal. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?

### 文章

In the digital age, technology has fundamentally transformed how humans interact with one another. While some argue that these changes have diminished the personal nature of communication, I partially agree with this view, as technology has both enhanced and hindered personal connections depending on how it is utilized.

On one hand, technology has indeed created barriers to meaningful personal interaction. Face-to-face conversations, which allow for nuanced emotional expression through body language and tone, are increasingly replaced by text messages and emails that lack these crucial non-verbal cues. Moreover, the prevalence of social media has fostered superficial relationships where people maintain hundreds of online "friends" but may struggle to form deep, authentic connections. The phenomenon of individuals sitting together while absorbed in their devices, rather than engaging with those physically present, exemplifies how technology can create emotional distance even in physical proximity.

However, technology has also revolutionized communication in profoundly positive ways. Video calling platforms enable families separated by vast distances to maintain visual contact and share important moments in real-time. Social media and messaging apps have reconnected old friends and allowed people with niche interests to find like-minded communities globally. During the COVID-19 pandemic, technology proved essential for maintaining personal relationships when physical meetings were impossible, demonstrating its capacity to preserve rather than diminish personal connections.

Furthermore, the quality of communication largely depends on individual choices rather than the technology itself. Those who use digital tools mindfullyscheduling regular video calls with loved ones, sharing meaningful content, and setting boundaries on device usagecan maintain deeply personal relationships. Conversely, even traditional face-to-face interactions can be impersonal if participants are disengaged or superficial.

In conclusion, while technology has introduced challenges to personal communication, particularly through the reduction of face-to-face interaction and the rise of superficial online relationships, it has simultaneously created unprecedented opportunities for maintaining and developing personal connections across distances. The key lies not in the technology itself but in how consciously and purposefully we choose to use it.

Rich countries often give money to poorer countries, but it does not solve poverty. Therefore, develop countries should give other types of help to poorer countries rather than financial aid. To what extend do you agree or disagree?

### 文章

Wealthier nations are in great efforts to support poorer ones in solving famine by providing them with financial support. However, it is of the opinion that this type of help does not work, therefore, more effective alternatives are required. Personally, I am inclined to agree with this notion.

On the one hand, it is undeniable that financial aid can provide immediate relief in times of crisis, like natural disasters and health emergencies. It can help save lives and mitigate suffering. For example, locking down during the COVID-19 pandemic has exhausted the global economy, especially in underdeveloped and developing countries. Thus, money received from rich nations can help citizens from poorer ones meet basic needs such as clothes, food, medicine and accommodation. Additionally, in some cases, monetary assistance can help poorer countries develop basic infrastructure, including building roads, hospitals and schools, contributing to long-term development.

Firstly, it is essential to have a quality education which is considered a sustainable pathway to economic development. A quality education can equip individuals with the necessary skills and knowledge that can improve their lives and contribute to their communities. When children access education, they can break down the cycle of poverty by securing their job opportunities and making informed decisions about health and well-being. It is expected by the United Nations that the GDP of poor regions may increase by 70% if all children can access education. Secondly, rich nations can transfer modern technology to poorer ones as a form of support. It is true that the adoption of advanced machines in the farming sector can boost agricultural productivity. This in turn can help them not only secure domestic food safety but also promote exporting, leading to an increase in overall income. To illustrate, a statistical report from the World Bank revealed that thanks to modern technology applied in the agricultural sector, the crop yields of Southern Asia have increased by 6 times during the last 40 years, contributing to the significant reduction of poverty in this area.

In conclusion, although financial aid can solve the problem of poverty to some extent, I firmly assert that providing poorer nations with quality education and modern technology is a more sustainable solution, helping these countries overcome impoverishment in the long term.

The popularity of extreme sports has sparked a profound debate among the public. Some contend that these games should be prohibited due to safety issues, whereas others believe that people should be free to do any sports activity. In this essay, both sides will be explored, followed by my opinion.

On the one hand, proponents of prohibition argue that dangerous sports bring numerous risks to players. To be more specific, they are dealing with life-threatening perils when playing these games, especially those involving specialized equipment such as skydiving, motor racing and jump base. For example, people who skydive are required to obtain a USPA "A" licence before they want to skydive alone without supervision. In addition, in some cases, dangerous sports can lead to remarkable achievement and global recognition for athletes. This recognition can be a source of inspiration and pride. For instance, two Vietnamese athletes became national pride when they set their Guinness Records for consecutively climbing stairs while balancing a person on their heads.

In conclusion, although safety concerns and the violent content in some dangerous sports are critical, I firmly believe that people should be free to do any sports of their choice. ### 文章

Some argue that working in international settings offers experts expanded benefits and possibilities. Conversely, others believe remaining in one's native country is the better choice. I completely agree with the first mindset.  Interacting with diverse international concepts and contexts can endow individuals with invaluable exposure to a wide range of perspectives. This, in turn, has the potential to significantly enhance their knowledge and understanding of the topics they have studied. The ability to consider multiple viewpoints and draw from a broader range of experiences can lead to more nuanced, well-rounded expertise. Furthermore, international engagement also offers unique access to diverse professional networks across the globe. Connecting with professionals worldwide can open up new avenues for collaboration, knowledge sharing, and career advancement. A prime example of these benefits occurred during the COVID-19 pandemic global collaboration and sharing of knowledge between experts was instrumental in rapidly advancing the understanding and treatment of the virus.  Working in an international context can also foster the development of highly sought-after skills. Individuals immersed in such environments are required to navigate a multitude of cultural, linguistic, and adaptive challenges, leading to the acquisition of proficiencies in areas like language, cross-cultural communication, and adaptability. These capabilities are increasingly valuable in today's globalized job market. Moreover, the personal transformation that can occur when working internationally should not be overlooked. Exposure to diverse cultures, new modes of thinking, and unfamiliar surroundings can catalyze profound personal growth, instilling greater self-awareness, open-mindedness, and a more expansive, global perspective. The enriching life experiences gained through international work can be just as impactful as the professional development achieved.  While some argue that young people should prioritize rebuilding and improving their local communities rather than seeking opportunities abroad, l completely reject it. I believe that the potential lack of advancement opportunities and shortage of expert talent in one's home country can be a compelling reason for seeking international work experience. By gaining exposure to different cultures, systems, and ways of thinking in other parts of the world, individuals can acquire valuable skills, perspectives, and experiences that they can then bring back and apply to help contribute to the progress and evolution of their home communities.  In conclusion, the benefits of working in international environments, from enhanced expertise and professional networks to personal growth and skill development, make a compelling case for embracing the opportunities that cross-border collaboration can offer.

## 第1009篇

Band 8.5

### 题目

An increasing number of professionals, such as, teachers and doctors are leaving their own countries to work in developed countries. What are the causes of this problems? What solutions can you suggest?

### 文章

The increasing migration of professionals, such as teachers and doctors, from developing to developed countries is a significant trend in today’s globalized workforce. This phenomenon stems from both individual aspirations and organizational demands. However, governments and employers in developing nations can implement measures to mitigate this talent drain.

A key reason for this issue lies in the appeal of developed nations. On an individual level, they offer better career opportunities, such as higher salaries, comprehensive welfare systems, and access to state-of-the-art infrastructure. For instance, countries like the U.S. attract engineers with cutting-edge industries and competitive benefits. Additionally, these nations often provide safer work environments and better quality of life, making them desirable destinations. At an organizational level, the rise of outsourcing and offshoring has further incentivized businesses to recruit talent globally, leveraging diverse perspectives to enhance innovation and market expansion.

To address this issue, governments in developing countries must stimulate economic growth and create more attractive job opportunities. Investing in technology and green industries, as well as fostering international trade, can generate employment and reduce the allure of working abroad. Furthermore, enforcing stricter regulations to combat workplace harassment and improve occupational safety would ensure employees feel secure in their jobs. Employers should also promote work-life balance, offer competitive compensation, and foster inclusive workplaces where employees feel valued and respected.

In conclusion, while the migration of skilled professionals is driven by personal and organizational factors, proactive measures by governments and local employers can help retain talent and reduce the reliance on foreign opportunities.

### 分数

Band 8.5

### 题目

Developed countries have created many environmental problems, particularly in contributing to global warming. Why is global warming a problem? What can be done to reduce the dangers of global warming?

### 文章

Global warming has worsened due to the activities of numerous industrial nations, primarily driven by factories and sweatshops. Nevertheless, this issue could be mitigated by applying a comprehensive approach.

The primary contributor is harmful emissions from industrial factories. Technological advancements have led to many automated manufacturing chains, meeting the demands of a burgeoning population. However, this requires a higher volume of fossil fuels in the production process, leading to more greenhouse gases, such as carbon dioxide and carbon monoxide. Furthermore, transportation activities, including foreign tourism and global trading, have exacerbated this condition. For example, global merchandise trading requires more high-volume vessels to transport products from manufacturing sites to targeted markets. Consequently, this transportation process has contributed significantly to carbon dioxide emissions. Additionally, many harmful substances used in commercial products have generated significant ramifications for surrounding water environments and air quality. Perhaps the most detrimental compounds are CFCs, which were used in many refrigerators in the past. Reports by reputable organizations indicated that CFCs were a major factor leading to ozone depletion, causing knock-on effects, including melting polar ice caps, ocean expansion, and changes in weather patterns, including precipitation and extreme weather events.

Firstly, CO2 allowances and relevant regulations need to be enacted immediately by governments to curb this urgent issue. This requires all factories to comply with environmental laws and reduce the total volume of greenhouse gases, as all industrial plants must buy carbon credits equal to their emissions. As a result, the world will achieve CO2 neutrality, deterring knock-on ramifications and enhancing human well-being. Secondly, governments should encourage replacing coal-powered plants with nuclear power and other renewable energy sources. Authorities need to introduce lists of banned chemical compounds harmful to the environment. For instance, after publishing extensive scientific evidence about the harmful effects of CFCs, their subsequent global ban helped curb ozone depletion.

To conclude, high-tech industrial infrastructure, transportation processes, and some commercial products are the primary sources of global warming. Ultimately, the mentioned methods, including CO2 allowances, stricter environmental regulations, using renewable energy sources, and prohibiting harmful chemical substances, could be applied to solve this issue.

For example, now you can upload items to a ‘cloud’, or play more advanced games, but neither of these advancements in any way compares to the early time phones were released to the public.

Similarly to the above, the early computers also transformed the way companies ran their businesses. Previously there were filing cabinets full of paperwork and accessing that information could take hours to locate the piece of information that you wanted. In ,contrast though, computers have been around for so long now that they have almost reached their limit in terms of how useful they could possibly be. For example, the only real modification that happens now is new releases of the Windows operating system and the so-called growth is actually just considered an annoying transformation to many rather than actual progress.

In summary, the most profound long-lasting impacts that technology has brought us occurred many years ago. These days’ beneficial development now comes in very small increments and I believe that will continue to be the case in the future.

## 第1024篇

### 分数

Band 8.5

### 题目

Foreign visitors should pay more than local visitors for cultural and historical attractions. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion.

### 文章

In the modern world, international travel is becoming increasingly common. Some individuals argue that overseas tourists should be charged more than the resident population when they visit the same tourist attractions. Personally, I completely disagree with this idea.

To begin with, one argument in favour of higher prices for foreign visitors is that many cultural and historical attractions are typically funded by the government, meaning that local residents have already contributed to these sites through the tax system. Therefore, it is believed that locals should either be granted free access or charged less than individuals from other countries. However, I contend that this is a short-sighted view because an increase in the number of foreign tourists contributes not only to the development of national tourism but also to the growth of related sectors such as food, accommodation, and transportation. As a result, employees in these industries are likely to earn higher salaries. Additionally, the government can benefit from increased revenue, which can then be allocated to the preservation and protection of domestic cultural heritage, creating a virtuous cycle of local economic growth and cultural conservation.

Moreover, from the perspective of foreign visitors, they are likely to be less willing to visit a country that does not treat them equally to its citizens. Evidence suggests that travellers prefer destinations that are friendly and hospitable. For instance, China has attracted a greater number of people from the rest of the world in 2024, as the Chinese government has introduced a series of policies to welcome foreigners, ensuring that both visitors and locals have access to the same services at various attractions. Conversely, if overseas travellers are treated differently and charged higher fees than local residents, they might choose to visit other countries instead. After all, international travel has become more convenient with the recovery of global transportation networks.

In conclusion, whether from the perspective of individuals, businesses, or governments, I believe it is a poor practice to charge different fees to different groups of people.

### 分数

Band 8.5

### 题目

Government should spend money on railways rather than roads. To what extend to you agree or disagree?

### 文章

It is often argued that governments should allocate more resources to the development of railways rather than roads. Although some might disagree with this statement, I fully agree with this statement because trains offer more efficient transportation of goods and people, are more cost-effective, and are significantly better for the environment. This essay will examine these points in detail to support my opinion.

To begin with, one of the primary reasons governments should invest in railroads is their superior efficiency in transporting large volumes of both goods and passengers. Unlike road-based logistics, which are limited by the capacity of individual vehicles, freight trains can move huge quantities over long distances with fewer trips. For instance, China’s extensive high-speed rail network has revolutionized both passenger travel and the transportation of essential commodities, reducing travel time and increasing the flow of goods across the country. Thus, this factor can almost single-handedly express my view.

Moreover, metros are more cost-effective in the long term. Whereas surface networks are crucial for short distances, they are more expensive to maintain and rely heavily on fossil fuels, such as petrol and diesel, which are costly and subject to price fluctuations. In contrast, railcars, especially electric ones, are cheaper to operate and maintain, particularly for long-distance. To illustrate, India, where millions of people rely on the railway system daily is the most affordable and accessible means of transport, not only for individuals but also for businesses that depend on low-cost freight services. Hence, this factor clearly justifies my point of view.

Another key reason to prioritize rail lines is their environmental benefits. As global awareness of climate change grows, reducing greenhouse gas emissions has become a critical issue. Subways, especially those powered by electricity, contribute far less to pollution compared to motor vehicles. Like French TGV (Train à Grande Vitesse) operates entirely on electricity and emits very little carbon dioxide, offering a sustainable alternative to road transportation.

In conclusion, I strongly believe that governments should focus more on developing railway infrastructure rather than expanding land networks. Rail infrastructure not only offers greater efficiency and cost savings but also represents a more sustainable and environmentally friendly option. Therefore, prioritizing railways is a wise decision that will benefit both economies and the planet in the long term.

For centuries, human actions have persistently jeopardized the natural environment. While some argue that these harmful activities are irreversible, others remain optimistic that the natural habitat can still be rescued through timely and effective remedial strategies. I believe that governments must implement decisive measures to mitigate environmental degradation, as the potential for changing human behaviour could significantly improve the situation. This essay will explore why some people are pessimistic about environmental recovery, while others, including myself, remain hopeful.

On one hand, many people feel that despite numerous efforts to conserve the environment, significant damage continues due to deliberate human negligence. Even when regulations are enacted to protect natural habitats, adherence to these rules often falls short. This failure leads to ongoing environmental destruction, particularly in developing countries where enforcement is weak. For instance, despite various conservation initiatives, deforestation and illegal poaching remain rampant in many regions, exacerbating environmental degradation. Such persistent disregard for environmental protection fuels the belief that meaningful change is unattainable.

On the other hand, there is a compelling argument that governments can and should play a pivotal role in reversing environmental damage. Increased governmental oversight and stricter enforcement of environmental laws can lead to more responsible behaviour. For example, several developed nations have successfully preserved their ecosystems by implementing stringent penalties for environmental violations, coupled with public awareness campaigns. These actions have fostered a culture of environmental stewardship, suggesting that with the right strategies, significant progress can be made.

In conclusion, although humans have contributed significantly to environmental degradation, there is still hope for improvement through governmental intervention. Governments have the authority and resources to enforce laws that can mitigate the harmful effects of human activities on the environment. By combining strict regulations with education, we can cultivate a more environmentally conscious society, ultimately safeguarding our planet for future generations.

Importance should be given to the academic subjects by the schools. Music and sports should not be as a subject. Do you agree or disagree. Give reasons and examples for your answer.

Some people believe that only academic disciplines should be considered significant in school, while music and sports should be disregarded as unimportant. However, I completely disagree with this viewpoint. In my opinion, artistic and physical abilities are crucial for learners’ holistic development and should be given equal importance. In my essay, I will elaborate on why music and physical education are essential components of a well-rounded education.

First and foremost, musical subjects play a vital role in nurturing young people’s emotional and creative development. Music provides pupils with a unique avenue to express their emotions and thoughts in ways that words alone cannot achieve. For instance, engaging with music allows individuals to process complex feelings, contributing to emotional intelligence and mental well-being. A study published in Frontiers in Psychology found that music significantly enhances emotional regulation in children. By participating in music classes, individuals learn to manage and articulate their emotions, leading to improved coping mechanisms and better mental health. Additionally, music education fosters creativity and critical thinking, skills that are transferable to other areas of study and life challenges. The ability to think creatively and manage emotions is indispensable in today’s rapidly changing world.

Furthermore, physical education is equally important as it promotes both physical health and mental well-being. Regular participation in sports and physical activities is essential for maintaining physical fitness, which directly impacts individuals’ ability to focus and perform well in academic endeavours. Beyond physical health, physical education offers significant mental health benefits. For example, a study published in the Journal of Sport and Exercise Psychology found that regular exercise helps young people manage stress and anxiety by triggering the release of endorphins, which are natural mood enhancers. Moreover, physical education teaches valuable life skills like teamwork, discipline, and perseverance, which are crucial for personal and professional success. These lessons are not only applicable in sports but also in academic pursuits and future career endeavours.

In conclusion, I firmly believe that music and physical education should be regarded as essential elements of the school curriculum. These activities contribute to the holistic development of learners by enhancing their emotional intelligence, creativity, physical health, and mental well-being. Ignoring the importance of these areas would be a disservice to young people, depriving them of the opportunities to develop skills and traits that are invaluable in both their academic and personal lives. Therefore, schools should prioritize a balanced curriculum that includes both academic and non-academic subjects, ensuring that learners receive a comprehensive education.

### 题目

In many cities the use of video cameras in public places is being increased in order to reduce crime, but some people believe that these measures restrict our individual freedom. Do the benefits of increased security outweigh the drawbacks.

### 文章

In today’s world, video surveillance is widely used in public areas in many cities for crime prevention. While some individuals consider this measure to be an invasion of privacy, I contend that the advantages of using CCTV surpass its disadvantages.

To begin with, there are several major reasons why opponents maintain that security systems should not be used in communal spaces. Firstly, they argue that monitoring devices observe people without permission, which violates their privacy. Consequently, the public experiences less freedom and constantly feels watched by the authorities, causing increased pressure and negatively impacting their mental well-being. Additionally, without a transparent and effective supervisory mechanism, surveillance systems may be utilized by relevant organizations for illegal or unethical purposes. Furthermore, the data collected by these systems is at risk of leakage due to hacker attacks. If this information falls into the hands of criminals, both individuals and society may suffer serious consequences.

On the other hand, I believe that the benefits of monitoring outweigh the drawbacks. One of the main advantages is that it can deter potential offenders from committing crimes, thereby significantly reducing crime rates and creating a safer and more harmonious community. For instance, since the introduction of video technology in the public transport system, terrorist threats, such as bombings, have almost disappeared in China. Moreover, these devices provide valuable support for law enforcement agencies. Officers are able to use video evidence to catch criminals, greatly increasing their work efficiency. As a result, governments can employ fewer personnel while effectively serving the same population. The savings from reducing the number of officers can be reallocated to other essential infrastructure and public services.

In conclusion, while it is understandable why some critics argue against using surveillance in public places, I contend that the beneficial effects of this measure outweigh the detrimental ones.

## 第1031篇

### 分数

Band 8.5

### 题目

In many countries around the world, rural people are moving to cities, so the population in the countryside is decreasing. Do you think this is a positive or a negative development?

### 文章

In recent decades, a significant shift has been observed globally, with rural inhabitants increasingly relocating to urban centres, leading to a gradual decline in the population of the countryside. This phenomenon, often referred to as rural exodus, has sparked considerable debate regarding its consequences. In my view, while this trend does offer certain economic advantages, it is predominantly a negative development due to the adverse effects it imposes on both urban and rural communities.

On the one hand, the movement of people from rural to urban areas can be seen as a response to the greater socioeconomic opportunities available in cities. Urban centres typically provide superior employment prospects, higher wages, and access to better education and healthcare facilities. For instance, in many developing nations such as India, young individuals from villages often migrate to metropolitan areas like Mumbai or Delhi to secure jobs in the manufacturing or service sectors, thereby escaping poverty and improving their standard of living. This influx of labour also fuels urban economic growth, which can be beneficial at a national level.

On the other hand, the drawbacks of this demographic shift are substantial and far-reaching. The depopulation of rural areas leads to the neglect of agricultural land, the loss of traditional cultural practices, and the deterioration of local infrastructure and services such as schools and hospitals. For example, in parts of rural China, the mass exodus of working-age adults has resulted in entire villages being abandoned, leaving behind only the elderly, who struggle to maintain the land. Meanwhile, cities become overcrowded, straining public transport, housing, and sanitation systems, which exacerbates issues like pollution and social inequality. Consequently, the negative repercussions of this trend often outweigh the benefits, as both regions suffer from an imbalance of resources and population.

In conclusion, although rural-to-urban migration can provide individuals with enhanced opportunities, it is largely a negative development because it undermines the sustainability of rural communities and overburdens urban infrastructure. To mitigate these problems, governments should invest in rural development, such as creating job opportunities, modernising facilities, and promoting tourism, thereby encouraging a more balanced population distribution. Without such interventions, the continuing decline of the countryside will likely lead to greater social and environmental challenges.

## 第1038篇

### 分数

Band 8.5

### 题目

In some countries, children are often told that they can achieve anything if they try hard enough. What are the advantages and disadvantages of giving children this message?

### 文章

Some children are advised to devote themselves as much as possible so that they can attain their goals. This essay will suggest that a growth mindset and increased motivation are the biggest advantages of this, but disillusionment with truth and disregard for external factors are the primary disadvantages. 

The main advantages of encouraging minors to attempt to accomplish their objectives are cognitive development and enhanced determination. The belief that there are limitless possibilities allows minors not only to take on new experiences but also to view challenges as opportunities for self-improvement and self-exploration, which is of fundamental importance to their mindset. Furthermore, words of encouragement do instil great resolution and confidence in juveniles so that they can recover more quickly after failure. For example, teenagers who engage in skateboarding and are often taught to get up after they fall show stronger perseverance than their peers. 

Despite these advantages, children will soon be disappointed about unfulfilled results, and sometimes they seem to neglect what else matters to their goals. Firstly, when children realize that they cannot make any further progress regardless of their expenditure on work, they are likely to feel completely disheartened, which undermines their confidence and self-esteem. Secondly, an overemphasis on final results can lead to the underestimation of other factors that are partly essential for the achievement such as well-being, social relationships, or leisure pursuits. There are a plethora of reasons for this, and possible solutions can be suggested too, which are discussed as follows.

In regard to the issue, the major reason which can be stated is the unequal distribution of resources. This leads to significant disparities in nourishment availability across different regions, causing some areas to experience severe shortages while others have excess supply. In support of this reason, a known fact is that wealthier countries often have an abundance of provisions, while poorer nations struggle to meet basic nutritional needs. Another problematic cause is the impact of climate change, which greatly contributes to crop failures and scarcity of produce. For instance, prolonged droughts and extreme weather conditions have devastated agricultural outputs in many parts of the world.

Seeing the challenge with a brighter mind, many solutions can be helpful to curb this menace. One of the solutions is implementing laws to ensure fair distribution of essential supplies. This perspective is supported by examples of countries that have successfully reduced hunger through subsidy programs. Secondly, improving education on sustainable farming practices can lead to increased agricultural productivity. For example, teaching farmers about crop rotation and soil preservation can enhance food security. Lastly, promoting alternatives to traditional farming, such as hydroponics and vertical farming, can further increase production in areas with limited arable land.

In summary, the problem arises from multiple factors, including unequal resource distribution and climate change. The primary responsibility for solving this issue rests with both governments and individuals, who must work collaboratively to implement fair policies, educate farmers, and promote innovative agricultural practices. By addressing these root causes, it is possible to alleviate global hunger and ensure food security for all.

For instance, news websites provide real-time updates, eliminating the need for daily hardcopy publications. In addition, many online platforms offer free access to e-books, making reading more affordable.

On the other hand, print media still holds its own sentimental and collectable value. These physical media provide sensory and emotional experiences that digital media cannot replicate. Moreover, some people are concerned about security when reading online because it can be more easily tracked and analyzed. For example, holding a well-bound book, feeling the texture of the pages, and the distinct smell of ink all contribute to a unique reading experience. 

In conclusion, while the digital age has transformed our reading habits and led to a decline in the purchase of physical publications, it would be too early to predict their complete extinction. Convenience and cost-effective online content are undeniable advantages, the sensory experience and emotional connection offered by print media ensure that conventional reading material will maintain a place in our future. Balancing tradition and innovation will be the key to the survival of these two forms of media in the years to come.

### 题目

In the past, people stored knowledge in the book. Nowadays, people store knowledge on the internet. Do you think advantages outweigh disadvantages?

### 文章

Thanks to the significant development of technology, people prefer storing knowledge on the Internet rather than in traditional paper books. In this essay, I will discuss both the pros and cons of this trend and present my perspective.

On the one hand, one of the drawbacks of storing information online is the potential for health problems. Reading from technological devices such as smartphones, computers, or laptops can cause eye issues and disrupt sleep patterns due to the blue light effect. For example, according to a Vinmec report in 2023, more than 60% of people aged 7 to 14 years old have developed short-sightedness as a consequence of too early and frequent contact with digital screens. Moreover, students who are continuously accessing data online can be exposed to some online distractions. Therefore, they can easily get sidetracked watching humorous videos, surfing newsfeeds on Facebook, or even spending hours on their favourite game. Consequently, their working or studying productivity and quality can be lower. 

On the other hand, the Internet offers enormous storage and  promotes instant access. By providing information online, people can promptly access a vast array of resources regardless ò their time and location. Additionally, online libraries can be cost-effective both for book collections and for maintenance. Reading e-books, e-magazines, or digital references often requires only a small fee, and sometimes it is free. This development significantly increases the literacy rate, especially in rural areas. For instance, thanks to Khan Academy, millions of students from developing countries are able to learn numerous K12 courses ranging from Algebra, Geometry, Physics, Geography to Microeconomics or Government and Politics with only a connected computer.

In conclusion, although storing information on the Internet can lead to health problems and distractions, I believe the advantages of being more accessible and cost-effective outweigh these disadvantages.

It is a natural process that some animal species are extinct (e.g. dinosaur and dodos no longer exist). There is no reason that some people try to prevent this from happening. Do you agree or disagree?

### 文章

It is argued that animal extinction is a natural process, so humans have no justifiable reason to avert it. I disagree with this notion.

Admittedly, the disappearance of certain animals such as dinosaurs and dodos is considered natural because it occurs without direct human influence, like asteroid impact or volcanic eruptions, so it cannot be prevented. However, I am convinced that it remains our responsibility to prevent this phenomenon from happening. Specifically, there is no denying that human activities, such as deforestation and industrial pollution, have led to habitat loss and pollution, which are the primary reasons for animal extinction. Since humans are the drivers of ecological destruction, it is their duty to ensure animals’ existence. By doing so, we are not only fulfilling our moral duty toward nature, but we are also helping create a planet full of diversity for future generations to appreciate.

In addition, apart from fulfilling our ethical responsibility, I am sure that our efforts to halt animals’ death may open new avenues for scientific discoveries, which could bring immense benefits to mankind. For instance, the Sumatran Orangutan, a highly endangered species today, is worth protecting. If we ignore them, we will not be able to utilize them when conducting scientific research involving evolution and genetics. When this happens, understanding their close genetic relationship with humans as well as the possibility of scientific breakthroughs like cloning or medical advancements will not be possible.

In conclusion, although I find it admissible that certain animals no longer exist due to natural reasons, we must still recognize our ethical responsibility and animals’ potential contributions to scientific discovery, so we should exert more effort on protecting them than neglecting them.

### 文章

In recent years, the increasing use of modern devices by younger generations has coincided with a noticeable decline in traditional reading. While some argue that this trend brings numerous advantages, others view it as a cause for concern. This essay will explore both perspectives before offering my own opinion.

To begin with, supporters of digital tools highlight the vast educational opportunities they provide. For instance, interactive learning platforms such as Duolingo and Khan Academy have been shown to significantly enhance engagement and information retention. Furthermore, modern technology grants young learners access to an immense array of resources, thereby stimulating curiosity and broadening global awareness. According to a 2021 UNESCO report, more than 70% of students in developed nations regularly use online platforms to delve into subjects beyond their classroom education. Consequently, technology serves as a powerful tool for enriching knowledge and fostering intellectual growth. What’s more, the flexible and interactive nature of these platforms allows students to explore topics in personalized, engaging ways that may not be possible through conventional learning methods.

However, critics argue that excessive dependence on digital devices may hinder mental growth in important areas that are nurtured through traditional reading methods. Specifically, engaging with traditional texts promotes deeper focus, patience, and a stronger capacity for comprehension. A study conducted by the American Psychological Association found that reading long-form texts stimulates mental imagery and enhances creativity, which are crucial for developing empathy and critical thinking skills. In stark contrast, prolonged screen time, particularly when associated with fast-paced content, has been linked to shorter attention spans. For example, research from Stanford University in 2022 showed that students who spent more than three hours a day using electronic devices performed worse on reading comprehension tests than those who dedicated more time to reading printed materials. Thus, the decline in book reading could negatively impact essential cognitive and emotional growth.

Books, on the other hand, encourage immersion in intricate narratives, fostering critical thinking and introspection. In contrast, digital content is typically consumed more rapidly, which can lead to superficial understanding rather than thorough analysis. Numerous studies have shown that reading longer works improves memory retention and vocabulary expansion. Therefore, achieving a balance between screen-based activities and traditional reading is vital for well-rounded cognitive advancement.

In conclusion, while digital technologies undoubtedly provide significant educational advantages, the unique benefits that come from reading books should not be overlooked. Both methods are valuable, and a balanced approach, incorporating digital learning alongside traditional reading, is key to nurturing intellectual and emotional progress. In my view, combining these two forms of learning will ensure that young people acquire not only knowledge but also the critical thinking and creativity necessary for holistic intellectual development.

## 第1075篇

### 分数

Band 8.5

### 题目

Many cities suffer from traffic congestion. What are the causes and solutions?

### 文章

Traffic gridlock remains a pervasive issue in modern metropolises, frequently resulting in lost productivity alongside environmental degradation. Such a predicament stems from both infrastructural limitations and ingrained societal habits, one that necessitates a multi-pronged approach for its resolution.

Perhaps the most significant contributor to this phenomenon is the disproportionate reliance on private vehicles. In numerous urban areas, public transit systems are either unreliable or poorly integrated, which leaves residents with little alternative but to favour the comfort and autonomy of a car. Compounding this problem is the reality that rapid urban expansion often outpaces infrastructure development; many city centres possess narrow, historical road layouts that simply cannot accommodate the volume of modern automobiles. It is when thousands of single-occupancy vehicles converge on these outdated networks during peak hours that congestion becomes all but inevitable.

A viable response requires governments to prioritise the expansion and modernisation of commuter networks. Were authorities to invest more heavily in high-speed rail, dedicated bus lanes, and seamless local connectivity such as bike-sharing schemes, public travel would likely become a faster and more economical choice than driving. A complementary strategy involves economic deterrents; charging drivers a fee to enter central zones, a policy that has been implemented with considerable success in London, has proven effective in curbing unnecessary car usage. The revenue thus generated can then be directly reinvested into greener transport alternatives. Urban planners, for their part, should promote mixed-use development, ensuring that workplaces, schools, and amenities are within walking distance of residential areas, thereby reducing the necessity for long commutes.

In conclusion, although roadway saturation is a complex byproduct of urban growth and car culture, it is by no means insurmountable. Through robust infrastructure investment, smart pricing strategies, and thoughtful urban design, municipalities can significantly reduce delays and enhance the quality of life for their inhabitants.

## 第1080篇

### 分数

Band 8.5

### 题目

Many people argue that restaurants should be required to disclose the nutritional information of the dishes they serve. Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?

### 文章

It is often debated whether eating establishments ought to be mandated to publish the dietary and calorie breakdown of their meals. In contemporary society, rising public health concerns regarding obesity and poor diet have sparked a debate over transparency in the catering industry. While some argue that forcing eateries to print nutritional details creates unnecessary operational hurdles, I believe the positive impacts on public well-being heavily outweigh these challenges.

On the one hand, enforcing compulsory nutritional disclosure can place significant financial and administrative strain on independent food businesses. Unlike multinational franchises with standardised supply chains and centralised recipe testing, small family-owned bistros frequently alter their menus based on seasonal produce. Consequently, having dishes tested in laboratories to verify exact levels of sodium, fat, and calories can incur prohibitive recurring expenses. In addition to these testing fees, the ongoing cost of redesigning and reprinting physical menus imposes severe operational hardship on modest culinary ventures operating on razor-thin profit margins. Nevertheless, governments can mitigate these downsides through phased implementations, free standardised calculation software, or exemptions for micro-enterprises.

On the other hand, the societal health dividends of menu transparency are far more substantial. Requiring restaurants to make dietary values public empowers consumers to make informed choices, which is crucial for managing chronic lifestyle diseases such as diabetes, cardiovascular disease, and obesity. Furthermore, clear labelling assists individuals with severe food intolerances and allergies in avoiding potentially life-threatening ingredients. For instance, following the enforcement of mandatory calorie-labelling legislation across chain restaurants in New York City, public health assessments observed a measurable shift among patrons toward lower-calorie menu alternatives. When customers are fully aware of what their meals contain, they are far more likely to practice portion control, ultimately curbing long-term public healthcare expenditures.

In conclusion, although the obligation to reveal nutritional metrics may place a logistical and financial burden on smaller restaurateurs, this drawback can be addressed through targeted policy exemptions. The overarching benefit—equipping the population with the knowledge necessary to combat chronic diseases and maintain healthier lifestyles—is decisively more profound.

## 第1082篇

### 分数

Band 8.5

### 题目

Many people say that globalisation and the growing number of multinational companies have a negative effect on the environment. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Use specific reasons and examples to support your position.

### 文章

Globalisation has transformed the world by promoting international trade, investment, and economic growth. At the same time, the rapid expansion of multinational corporations has enabled businesses to operate on an unprecedented global scale. While these developments have undoubtedly brought significant economic benefits, I strongly agree that they have also had a largely detrimental impact on the environment due to increased industrial activity and excessive consumption.

One of the primary reasons for this environmental damage is the growth of large-scale manufacturing. To meet the ever-increasing global demand for goods, multinational companies establish factories in various countries, many of which rely heavily on fossil fuels. As a result, vast amounts of greenhouse gases and industrial waste are released into the atmosphere and nearby water bodies, contributing to climate change and environmental pollution. For example, many manufacturing hubs in developing countries have experienced severe air and water pollution because environmental regulations are often less strictly enforced than in developed nations.

Another major concern is the expansion of international transportation networks. Globalisation has created complex supply chains in which raw materials, components, and finished products are transported across continents by ships, trucks, and aircraft. These modes of transport consume enormous quantities of fuel and generate substantial carbon emissions. Moreover, multinational corporations often encourage a culture of mass consumption through aggressive advertising and frequent product launches. This leads consumers to replace perfectly usable products with newer versions, resulting in excessive waste, greater pressure on natural resources, and growing landfill sites.

Admittedly, some multinational companies have begun investing in renewable energy, environmentally friendly packaging, and sustainable production methods. However, these initiatives remain insufficient to offset the environmental costs associated with large-scale production and global distribution.

In conclusion, although globalisation has accelerated economic development and improved living standards in many parts of the world, I firmly believe that its environmental consequences are overwhelmingly negative. Unless governments and multinational corporations adopt more sustainable practices, environmental degradation is likely to become an even greater global challenge in the future.

## 第1088篇

### 分数

Band 8.5

### 题目

Many Working People Get Little or No Exercise either During the Working Day or in Their Free Time, and Have Health Problems as a Result. Why Do Many Working People Not Get Enough Exercise? What Can Be Done About This Problem?

### 文章

Some workers are not exercising enough during their daily routine and some of them are developing health issues as a consequence. This essay discusses the reasons behind this phenomenon and the solutions to the matter.

There are two main reasons why employees do not do physical activities regularly. The first of these is due to poor time management. This is because workers often schedule too many daily activities and end up not accomplishing some personal ones. For instance, home-based job workers often have trouble finishing tasks earlier to do their daily workouts. Moreover, tiredness is another common reason why people skip exercising. The reason for this is that workers usually finish their professional duties at night when they are too exhausted to go to the gym and, therefore, they might choose to spend the rest of the day resting.

However, some strategies might help mitigate these difficulties. Firstly, one should try exercising before engaging in their job. This is due to recent studies that have shown that working out in the morning brings more consistency to people's health routine since they usually feel more energetic at this time of the day. For example, the elderly tend to do physical activities in the morning because it is when their bodies are fully rested. Furthermore, having a gym partner helps the individual commit to their workout schedule. This is because doing sports can be more fun with a friend. In particular, workout partners can serve as mental support when one's lacking motivation.

In conclusion, the reasons why workers are skipping their exercise are related to poor time management and exhaustion after working all day. The possible solutions to this matter are going to the gym before work commitments and gathering workout partners.

## 第1089篇

### 分数

Band 8.5

### 题目

Memorising facts is the most important way to succeed in education. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

### 文章

Being well-educated is vital for growth, starting early in life and requiring significant dedication from both children and parents for many years. Given its significance, some individuals believe that memorising as much knowledge as possible is the key to academic success. However, I strongly disagree with this viewpoint.

Firstly, schooling is not merely about gathering information but about cultivating a deep understanding of knowledge. It is true that grasping concepts is the foundation of genuine learning. For example, during my history classes, I initially found it challenging to remember dates and events. However, when I shifted my focus to understanding the causes and effects of historical incidents, I found that I could not only retain the data more effectively but also participate in more meaningful discussions. Similarly, when examining a graph, simply knowing the numbers is insufficient; understanding the context, research methods, and  implications of the data leads to a more insightful and critical analysis. This approach encourages questioning and evaluating facts rather than accepting them without scrutiny.

Moreover, facts can become outdated or be subject to change. Scientific understanding, for instance, evolves as methods improve and new discoveries are made. A recent example is the evolving understanding of COVID-19. At the start of the pandemic, certain guidelines and insights were considered reliable, but as research progressed, advice and knowledge changed. Relying solely on memorised facts can therefore hinder one’s ability to adapt to new developments and advancements.

In conclusion, memorising data alone is not a dependable approach to achieving success in education. The ability to critically assess information, conduct research, and form independent opinions is far more valuable for long-term learning and personal development.

More and more people and organizations are using digital technology for contact with other people. What are the advantages and disadvantages of using digital technology for communication?

### 文章

In the modern world, the use of digital tools, especially in communication, is becoming increasingly common. I argue that the popularity of this trend has both benefits and drawbacks.

On the one hand, the widespread use of digital advancements positively impacts both people and businesses. Firstly, from a personal perspective, these tools enable individuals to stay in touch with family and friends more conveniently. Even if they live in different cities or countries, they can instantly connect with loved ones through mobile phones or the Internet. In contrast, in the past, underdeveloped communication methods often led to losing contact with relatives and friends due to long distances. Moreover, from a corporate standpoint, digital systems facilitate remote work. This allows companies to recruit top talent and collaborate with various institutions worldwide, increasing the likelihood of business success. Additionally, implementing remote work helps reduce operating costs, such as building and utility expenses. In fact, technological giants like Google have already introduced online work policies.

On the other hand, it is undeniable that these advancements have certain negative effects. Primarily, some people now prefer online interactions over face-to-face meetings, which can make it more challenging to build strong relationships, potentially leading to a more indifferent society. Additionally, the prevalence of mobile phones and Internet-based communication increases the risk of data breaches. Sensitive information may be exploited by criminals, posing challenges to both individual privacy and national security.

In conclusion, while the widespread use of digital tools offers significant advantages to people and businesses, I argue that we must also be mindful of its potential disadvantages.

### 分数

Band 8.5

### 题目

More and more students are choosing to study at colleges and universities in a foreign country. Do the benefits of studying abroad outweigh the drawbacks?

### 文章

In contemporary society, a growing number of students opting to pursue education abroad has sparked a degree of controversy among the public. While there are certain benefits to this tendency, I would argue that they are eclipsed by the disadvantages.

On the one hand, there are a number of positive effects when learners study abroad. First and foremost, as developed countries like the United Kingdom and the United States boast superior education systems and prestigious universities, scholars who study abroad can attain better qualifications. Consequently, they might secure higher-paying employment opportunities. Without the experience of studying abroad, they may encounter challenges in securing employment. Secondly, students reside far from their families and have to deal with daily challenges by themselves on their own, including grocery shopping and cooking, which can foster their personal growth and maturity. Conversely, if they attend domestic educational institutions, they will be less self-reliant.

On the other hand, I contend that the drawbacks are more significant than such advantages. To begin with, given the typically high living costs in developed countries, encompassing accommodation fees and food prices, undergraduates have to pay very high costs, thereby putting a financial burden on their parents. If they study in their home countries, they are likely to save a great amount of money. Furthermore, living far away from their families, students studying abroad may experience feelings of loneliness. For instance, they may lack support when they fall ill, which might negatively affect their academic performance.

In conclusion, although studying abroad offers undeniable advantages such as access to top-tier education and the promotion of independence, the considerable financial hardships and emotional difficulties involved suggest that the drawbacks outweigh the benefits. Therefore, individuals contemplating studying abroad must carefully weigh these factors before making a decision that aligns with their long-term goals and well-being.

## 第1097篇

### 分数

Band 8.5

### 题目

Most countries aim to improve their standard of living through economic development, but many important social values can be lost as a result.Do the advantages of economic development outweigh the disadvantages?

### 文章

Many nations strive to enhance their citizens' quality of life by pursuing economic growth, though this often leads to the erosion of cherished social values. Despite these losses, the benefits of economic development significantly surpass the drawbacks.

Economic growth is not without its challenges. One primary concern is the loss of cultural heritage. As countries modernize, traditional customs and practices can get sidelined in favour of more global, often Western, lifestyles. For instance, younger generations in rapidly developing nations might prefer fast food over traditional dishes, leading to a dilution of culinary heritage. Another significant disadvantage is environmental degradation. The drive for industrial expansion often results in substantial ecological damage. An example of this is seen in the deforestation of the Amazon Basin, where vast tracts of forest are cleared to make way for agriculture and mining, disrupting local ecosystems and contributing to global climate change.

On the other hand, economic development brings more substantial advantages. A primary benefit is the improvement in living standards. Increased economic activities lead to better employment opportunities, which in turn elevate household incomes and reduce poverty. South Korea’s transformation over the past fifty years, evolving from a war-ravaged country to a high-tech economy, exemplifies this, where the average income has significantly increased, enhancing overall living conditions. Furthermore, economic growth fuels advancements in healthcare and education. For example, increased revenues allow for greater public health expenditures, which have been instrumental in increasing life expectancy and reducing child mortality rates in places like the United Arab Emirates.

In conclusion, while it is necessary to address the issues of cultural erosion and environmental impact, the overall benefits in health, education, and living standards clearly demonstrate that the advantages of economic development outweigh the disadvantages.

This leads people to argue that a good narrative  must be delivered, or perhaps even more reported.

In detail, editors take into account various features that guarantee the audience's interest. News should have prominence, meaning consumers need to recognize the subject such as celebrities. It additionally needs to have timeliness which translates to being updated. Lastly, it must be significant, in other words, important to society. Moreover, these qualities make an event likely appealing to the public and are highly considered in decision-making regarding headlines.

While both types of narratives meet the aforementioned characteristics, editors commonly take advantage of the psychological habit of people to dwell on despicable stories or gossip. For instance, media coverage of Donald Trump's previous crime allegations during the United States elections completely overshadowed his past political achievements. Furthermore, studies show there is a human tendency to react more strongly to negative information in contrast to positive ones which subsequently leads to anxiety or mood disorders.

Nevertheless, according to another study, gratifying stories have been shown to boost dopamine levels which consequently improves mood as well as decreases depression.Therefore, it would be better to increase the number of uplifting broadcasts such as Carlos Yulo's double gold victory during the Paris Olympics which certainly makes individuals feel more elated, inspired and relieved. This is undoubtedly more beneficial than fixating on depressing topics that likely affect a person's mental well-being. 

In summary, news that is intriguing, timebound and relevant highly influences broadcasting. Correspondingly, these requirements are similarly met by both horrid and optimistic journals. Unfortunately, these factors are more utilized by negative controversy due to the likelihood that people’s curiosity is more drawn by horrible events despite their psychological impacts. Despite that, mood-lightening reports should be aired more to redirect the public’s focus to healthy journalism consumption rather than a toxic one which is proportional to  optimal psychological health.

Without taxes, the government would be unable to provide critical services such as healthcare, education, infrastructure, and public safety. For example, public hospitals and schools rely heavily on tax revenue to operate and maintain their services. If individuals kept all their earnings, these vital services would suffer, leading to a decline in the overall quality of life. Therefore, taxes are a necessary contribution to the common good, ensuring that essential services are available to all citizens.

Secondly, taxes play a crucial role in reducing income inequality and promoting social equity. Through a progressive tax system, where higher earners pay a larger percentage of their income, the government can redistribute wealth and provide support to the less fortunate. This helps to create a more balanced and fair society. For instance, social welfare programs and unemployment benefits, funded by taxes, offer a safety net for those in need. By contributing to these programs, individuals help to create a more just and equitable society. Thus, paying taxes is a way to ensure that everyone has access to basic necessities and opportunities for a better life.

In conclusion, I firmly disagree with the notion that people should keep all the money they earn and not pay taxes since taxes are indispensable for funding public services and reducing income inequality. Hence, ensuring a well-functioning society requires that everyone contributes their fair share through taxation.

Some people believe that charity organisations should help people wherever they live, others think they should help people in their country only. Discuss both views, give your opinion.

### 文章

People have different opinions on whether charitable institutions should serve those in need globally. While some argue that these groups are supposed to only offer help to residents in their own nations, I contend that nationality should not be the criterion when it comes to providing aid.

To begin with, one argument in favour of non-profit institutions focusing solely on their own countries is that the majority of these entities are normally funded by governments, meaning that it is the local population who contribute through taxes rather than individuals from abroad. Therefore, these groups should primarily support their own citizens instead of assisting those from other regions. Another key reason for this perspective is that some nations, especially impoverished ones, face serious societal problems, such as famine. As a result, aid organisations in these areas should concentrate their efforts on helping those within their borders who suffer from severe conditions. If they allocate their resources to assist others from different places, those in need at home may be neglected.

However, even if these notions are understandable in certain ways, I maintain that non-profits should treat everyone equally, regardless of nationality, for two major reasons. Firstly, all lives are of equal value; we have no right to determine whether saving one person is more important than another. Additionally, in a globalized era, every nation is interconnected. If a country, including its domestic aid groups, focuses solely on its own needs, it may become isolated from the rest of the global community. Consequently, when it faces challenges that it cannot handle alone, such as natural disasters, it may find itself without international support due to its past self-centeredness. Conversely, those nations that have fostered goodwill, such as China, are more likely to receive assistance in extreme situations. For example, China received help from around the globe when it faced an earthquake in 2008.

In conclusion, whether from an individual or national perspective, I believe that charities need to offer the same access to everyone worldwide; nationality should not be the criterion when offering assistance.

### 题目

Some people support modern developments in agriculture such as factory farming and creation of new types of fruits and vegetables. However, other people oppose this view. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

### 文章

Modern developments in agriculture, such as factory farming and the creation of new types of fruits and vegetables through genetic modification, are supported by some people for their potential to enhance food production and security. However, others oppose these practices owing to concerns about health risks and environmental impact. This essay will discuss both perspectives and argue that, despite some drawbacks, the benefits of these agricultural advancements outweigh their disadvantages.

Initially, the foremost benefit is the higher adaptation in severe natural habitats. Biologists can generate a better crop by breeding in the laboratory, which possesses some superior selected traits, particularly growth in tough climates including drought, salinity or poor fertility soil. The additional feature is the better resistance to pests, insects, fungi or bacteria of engineering plants, which minimizes the damage of these factors. To eliminate some health concerns related to some side effects of using pesticides and herbicides, farmers could cultivate pest resilience vegetables and minimize  fertilization labour efforts. As a result, reducing the damage involving severe habitat and the influences of insects can contribute to increasing crops harvested and ensuring a stable food supply. Besides, genetically modified plants have better nourishment and generate higher yield volume in comparison with native plants, which will solve some urgent issues, including malnutrition or some ailments owing to the lack of essential minerals.

Firstly, the chief disadvantage is health concerns from customers. The long-term effects of consuming genetically modified crops are still debated, with some studies suggesting potential health risks. There are some special cases reported in patients who were allergic immediately after eating an artificial bell pepper. Secondly, intensive farming practices can lead to soil degradation, water pollution, and loss of biodiversity due to abusive chemical products during cultivation. For example, abusive pesticides also lead to the diminishing of the bee population, and the shortage of natural pollinators results in lower yield harvested on the whole. 

To conclude, the higher adaptation, better resistance, and enhanced nutritional value of genetically modified crops can address issues like malnutrition and ensure global food security. Although there are valid health concerns and environmental risks associated with industrial farming, the overall advantages of modern agricultural developments for human well-being and cereal supply are significant. It is argued that government expenditure should be allocated towards services that benefit citizens instead of being spent on creative projects. I partly agree with this statement because art is important and can attract tourists; however, I believe that public amenities should receive a larger share of the country's budget due to their greater impact on the community.

Encouraging creativity by investing in the arts can attract more visitors to a country. Many travellers visit destinations to explore art museums, attend musical concerts, or admire unique architectural landmarks. Therefore, allocating a budget to the arts would not only support artists and musicians but also benefit the wider community by increasing tourism revenue and, consequently, the country’s GDP. For example, millions of travellers visit Paris and Vienna each year to explore their numerous art museums, which are supported by the French and Austrian governments. During their visits, travellers stay in hotels, dine at local restaurants and cafés, and shop at local businesses, ultimately contributing to the local economy.

Nonetheless, spending on public services should be a priority for governments. I believe that investing in healthcare, education, infrastructure and public safety provides greater benefits to society, as a healthy, educated and prosperous population can enhance a country’s international image and overall development. Moreover, beautiful scenery and cultural activities cannot compensate for poor infrastructure and inadequate public amenities , which may increase crime rates, create health concerns and discourage travelling individuals from visiting. For instance, some visitors may be reluctant to visit India because of concerns about poor infrastructure and inadequate public amenities, despite the country’s rich musical traditions and distinctive artistic culture.

In conclusion, although allocating money towards the arts is important, I believe that the government should allot a greater proportion of its expenditure to civic services due to their higher benefit to the local society and the country's international reputation.

### 文章

It is often argued that a competitive spirit in daily life and work is beneficial, while others believe that cooperation should be emphasized instead. I believe that competition is not inherently harmful unless it involves unethical means to achieve success.

On the one hand, proponents of cooperation argue that collaborating and supporting one another is the key to building a brighter future for everyone. Working together fosters stronger bonds between individuals, creating relationships founded on love and respect, which can help eliminate societal evils. In contrast, if people only worked individually, selfishness and jealousy could become widespread. This notion is evident in the world of politics, where history is replete with examples of power struggles, such as siblings betraying each other for the throne, assassination attempts, and other destructive acts.

On the other hand, humans are inherently driven by the desire for self-improvement and achievement. Although narcissism and excessive self-interest are negative traits that can lead to various problems, this instinct to compete can also motivate individuals to work hard and strive for excellence. Furthermore, when competitiveness is accompanied by a spirit of generosity and devoid of hatred, it creates a productive environment where everyone is motivated to improve themselves and contribute to their communities. For instance, when a student helps a classmate understand the syllabus, both benefit: the student solidifies their knowledge and enhances their interpersonal skills, while the classmate gains a clearer understanding of the material.

In conclusion, competition and cooperation should not be viewed as opposing forces but rather as complementary concepts. By combining the two, we can achieve both personal growth and societal progress.

Band 8.5

### 题目

Some people think that homeschooling should be banned because it has several drawbacks. Others think that it has a number of benefits. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

### 文章

Some are of the opinion that homeschooling ought to be prohibited due to its disadvantages, whereas others believe that it has several advantages. In my opinion, I consider that homeschooling is a great educational method which can benefit both parents and students. 

On the one hand, according to some, family-led education can result in a number of pitfalls. One of the main reasons is that when children are homeschooled, they will lack  social skills. In other words, going to school gives students the opportunity to mix with other children which can undoubtedly help them to develop their communication skills. However, if children study at home, they will most likely be alone most of the time. This will clearly impact their personalities negatively. Another reason why some oppose the idea of homeschooling is that it can be costly. Although parents can teach their children at home, not all parents have the knowledge to teach all subjects to their children. As a result, they have to hire private tutors to teach their children. In this case, they have to spend a lot of money, and for those who have financial issues, this can definitely affect their budgets. 

On the other hand, some people claim that home-based learning can bring about a number of merits, and I agree. Firstly, this educational method helps students learn effectively. That is to say, parents or tutors can slow the lesson based on their children' or students' performance. For instance, if students are weak in science, a teacher can slow down the lesson to ensure that they master the lesson effectively. Nevertheless, in a normal class, this cannot be done because a teacher has to follow the curriculum of the school. Secondly, with this educational option, parents can monitor their children's behaviour. These days, many children behave badly because they are affected by their peers. When children are at home with their parents, they can monitor them most of the time, and therefore, they will behave well. 

To sum up, while people may vary in their opinions, I think that homeschooling should not be banned owing to its positive aspects. If homeschooled were promoted, children would not only perform well academically but  also would have great personalities.
